sentences.zh: 志第十三曆二

translations.literal: Treatise 13, Calendars II
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 13: Calendars, Part Two

sentences.zh: ○麟德甲子元曆

translations.literal: ○ The Linde jiazi Era Origin Calendar
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Origin Calendar of the Linde jiazi Era

sentences.zh: 上元甲子，距今大唐甲子，歲積二十六萬九千八百八十算。

translations.literal: From the Superior Origin at jiazi to the present Great Tang jiazi year, the accumulated years are 269,880 counts.
translations.idiomatic: From the Superior Origin in the jiazi year to the present jiazi year of Great Tang, the elapsed years total 269,880 counts.

sentences.zh: 推法：一千三百四十。

translations.literal: Computation divisor: 1,340.
translations.idiomatic: Computation divisor: 1,340.

sentences.zh: 期實：四十八萬九千四百二十八。

translations.literal: True period constant: 489,428.
translations.idiomatic: True period value: 489,428.

sentences.zh: 旬周：六十。

translations.literal: Ten-day cycle: 60.
translations.idiomatic: Ten-day cycle: 60.

sentences.zh: ○推氣序術

translations.literal: ○ Method for deriving the sequence of qi
translations.idiomatic: ○ Procedure for calculating the order of the solar terms

sentences.zh: 置入甲子元積，算距今所求年，以期乘之，為期總。

translations.literal: Set in the jiazi era accumulated count; reckon the years from the present to the year sought; multiply by the period constant to obtain the period total.
translations.idiomatic: Enter the jiazi-era accumulated count; compute the years from the present back to the year sought; multiply by the period constant to obtain the period total.

sentences.zh: 滿法得一為積日，不滿為小餘。

translations.literal: When it fills the divisor, one is accumulated days; what does not fill is the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the divisor, that counts as one accumulated day; the remainder is the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 旬去積日，不盡為大餘。

translations.literal: Remove ten-day cycles from the accumulated days; what is not exhausted is the large remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Strip out full ten-day cycles from the accumulated days; what remains is the large remainder.

sentences.zh: 命大餘起甲子算外，即所求年天正中氣冬至恆日及大小餘。

translations.literal: From the large remainder, begin counting from jiazi outside the calculation—that is the fixed day of the winter solstice qi at celestial revolution for the year sought, together with large and small remainders.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from the large remainder, count from jiazi outside the reckoning—that gives the mean day of the winter solstice at the celestial first month for the year sought, with its large and small remainders.

sentences.zh: 天正建子，律氣所由，故陰陽發斂，皆從其時為自。

translations.literal: Celestial revolution establishes the first month; pitch-pipes and qi take their origin from this—hence the waxing and waning of yin and yang all proceed from this as their starting point.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial first month is established in the zi month; the pitch-pipes and solar terms take their origin from it—so the waxing and waning of yin and yang all begin from this point.

sentences.zh: ○求恆次氣術

translations.literal: ○ Method for finding the fixed successive qi
translations.idiomatic: ○ Procedure for finding the mean successive solar terms

sentences.zh: 因冬至大小餘，加大餘十五、小餘二百九十二、小分六之五。

translations.literal: From the winter solstice large and small remainders, add to the large remainder 15, to the small remainder 292, and five-sixths of a small fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Take the winter solstice large and small remainders; add 15 to the large remainder, 292 to the small remainder, and five-sixths of a minor fraction.

sentences.zh: 小分滿，從小餘。

translations.literal: When small fractions fill, carry to the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When minor fractions fill their unit, carry into the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 小餘滿總法之，從大餘一。

translations.literal: When the small remainder fills the common divisor, carry one to the large remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the small remainder fills the common divisor, carry one to the large remainder.

sentences.zh: 大餘滿旬周之。

translations.literal: When the large remainder fills the ten-day cycle, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When the large remainder fills the ten-day cycle, discard the cycle.

sentences.zh: 以次轉加，而命各得其所求。

translations.literal: In this manner add in turn and assign names—each yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding in sequence and assigning stem-branch names in turn—each step yields the term sought.

sentences.zh: 他皆放此。

translations.literal: All other cases follow this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All other cases follow this pattern.

sentences.zh: 凡氣餘朔大餘為日，小餘為辰也。

translations.literal: In general, the large remainder for qi remainders or new-moon remainders is the day, and the small remainder is the double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: In general, the large remainder in a qi or new-moon remainder is the day, and the small remainder is the double-hour.

sentences.zh: ○求土王

translations.literal: ○ Finding the days of Earthly Kingship
translations.idiomatic: ○ Finding the intercalary Earth days

sentences.zh: 置清明、小暑、寒露、小寒、大寒小餘，各加大餘十二、小餘二百四十四、小分八。

translations.literal: Set the small remainders for Pure Brightness, Minor Heat, Cold Dew, Minor Cold, and Great Cold; to each add large remainder 12, small remainder 244, and eight small fractions.
translations.idiomatic: Take the small remainders for Pure Brightness, Minor Heat, Cold Dew, Minor Cold, and Great Cold; to each add 12 to the large remainder, 244 to the small remainder, and eight minor fractions.

sentences.zh: 互乘氣小分通之，加八。

translations.literal: Cross-multiply the qi small fractions to common denominators and add eight.
translations.idiomatic: Cross-multiply the solar-term minor fractions to a common denominator and add eight.

sentences.zh: 若滿三十，去，從小餘一。

translations.literal: If it reaches thirty, remove it and carry one to the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If the total reaches thirty, discard thirty and carry one to the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 凡分餘相並不同者，互乘而並之。

translations.literal: Whenever fractional remainders to be combined differ, cross-multiply and combine them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever fractional remainders to be combined have different denominators, cross-multiply and combine them.

sentences.zh: 母相乘為法。

translations.literal: Multiply the denominators together to form the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the denominators together to form the divisor.

sentences.zh: 其並滿法一為全，此即齊同之術。

translations.literal: When the combination fills the divisor, one is complete—this is the method of making equal.
translations.idiomatic: When the combined numerator fills the divisor, that counts as one whole—this is the method of reduction to a common denominator.

sentences.zh: 小餘滿總法，從命如前，即各其氣從土王日。

translations.literal: When the small remainder fills the common divisor, carry to the name as before—each yields the day when Earth follows the qi.
translations.idiomatic: When the small remainder fills the common divisor, carry into the stem-branch name as before—each yields the intercalary Earth day following that solar term.

sentences.zh: 沒日法：一千七百五十七。

translations.literal: Buried-day divisor: 1,757.
translations.idiomatic: Buried-day divisor: 1,757.

sentences.zh: 沒分：十二萬二千三百五十七。

translations.literal: Buried-day fraction: 122,357.
translations.idiomatic: Buried-day fraction: 122,357.

sentences.zh: 求沒日術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding buried days
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding buried days

sentences.zh: 以九十乘有沒氣小餘，十五乘小分，從之，以減沒分，餘，法得一，為日。

translations.literal: Multiply by 90 the small remainder of the qi that has a buried day; multiply the small fraction by 15 and add; subtract this from the buried-day fraction; of the remainder, the divisor yields one as a day.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the small remainder of the qi that has a buried day by 90; multiply its minor fraction by 15 and add; subtract the sum from the buried-day fraction; divide the remainder by the divisor to obtain one day.

sentences.zh: 不盡，餘，以日數加其氣大餘。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is remainder; add the day-count to that qi's large remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is what is left; add the day-count to that qi's large remainder.

sentences.zh: 去命如前，即其氣內沒日也。

translations.literal: Remove and assign names as before—within that qi lies the buried day.
translations.idiomatic: Discard cycles and assign names as before—the buried day falls within that solar term.

sentences.zh: 小氣餘一千四十已上，其氣有沒者，勿推也。

translations.literal: When a minor qi's remainder is 1,040 or above, do not compute if that qi has a buried day.
translations.idiomatic: When a minor solar term's remainder is 1,040 or greater, do not compute a buried day for that term.

sentences.zh: 沒餘皆盡者為減。

translations.literal: When buried remainders are all exhausted, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: When the buried remainders are fully exhausted, subtract.

sentences.zh: 求次沒：因前沒加日六十九，餘一千一百四，餘滿從沒日一，因而命之，以氣別日。

translations.literal: To find the next buried day: from the preceding buried day add 69 days, remainder 1,104; when the remainder fills, carry one buried day and assign in turn, separating days by qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next buried day: from the previous buried day add 69 days with remainder 1,104; when the remainder fills the divisor, carry one buried day and assign names in turn, distinguishing days by solar term.

sentences.zh: 盈朔實：三萬九千九百三十三。

translations.literal: Excess new-moon constant: 39,933.
translations.idiomatic: Excess new-moon constant: 39,933.

sentences.zh: 朒朔實：三萬九千二百二十。

translations.literal: Deficiency new-moon constant: 39,220.
translations.idiomatic: Deficiency new-moon constant: 39,220.

sentences.zh: 恆朔實：三萬九千五百七十一。

translations.literal: Mean new-moon constant: 39,571.
translations.idiomatic: Mean new-moon constant: 39,571.

sentences.zh: 推朔端

translations.literal: Deriving the new-moon base
translations.idiomatic: Deriving the new-moon epoch

sentences.zh: 列期總，以恆朔實除之為積月，不滿為閏餘。

translations.literal: Arrange the period total; divide by the mean new-moon constant to obtain accumulated months; what does not fill is intercalary remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Set out the period total; divide by the mean new-moon constant to obtain accumulated months; the remainder is the intercalary remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿總法為閏日，不滿為閏辰。

translations.literal: When it fills the common divisor, one intercalary day; what does not fill is intercalary double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the common divisor, that is one intercalary day; the remainder is the intercalary double-hour.

sentences.zh: 以閏日減冬至大餘，辰減小餘，即所求年天正月恆朔大小餘。

translations.literal: Subtract the intercalary day from the winter solstice large remainder and the intercalary double-hour from the small remainder—that yields the large and small remainders for the mean new moon of the celestial first month for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the intercalary day from the winter solstice large remainder and the intercalary double-hour from the small remainder—that gives the large and small remainders for the mean new moon of the celestial first month for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 命大餘以甲子算外，即其日也。

translations.literal: From the large remainder begin counting from jiazi outside the calculation—that is the day.
translations.idiomatic: From the large remainder, count from jiazi outside the reckoning—that is the day.

sentences.zh: 天正者，日南至之月也。

translations.literal: Celestial first month is the month of the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial first month is the month in which the sun reaches its southern limit.

sentences.zh: 恆朔者，不朒不盈之常數也。

translations.literal: Mean new moon is the standard figure neither deficient nor excessive.
translations.idiomatic: The mean new moon is the standard interval neither shortened nor lengthened.

sentences.zh: 凡減者，小餘不足減，退大餘一，如總法而減之。

translations.literal: In general when subtracting, if the small remainder is insufficient, retreat one from the large remainder and subtract as if filling the common divisor.
translations.idiomatic: In general when subtracting, if the small remainder is insufficient, borrow one from the large remainder and subtract a full common divisor.

sentences.zh: 大餘不足減者，加旬周，乃減之。

translations.literal: When the large remainder is insufficient, add a ten-day cycle and then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: When the large remainder is insufficient, add a full ten-day cycle and then subtract.

sentences.zh: 其須減分奇者，退分餘一，如其法而減，以其在宿度遊實不足減者，加在宿過周連餘及奇，乃減之。

translations.literal: When fractional subtraction is needed, retreat one from the fractional remainder and subtract per its divisor; when what is in lodge-degree wandering constants is insufficient, add the excess of lodge-wandering cycle plus remainder and odd part, then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: When fractional subtraction is required, borrow one from the fractional remainder and subtract according to its divisor; when the wandering constant in lodge-degrees is insufficient, add the full lodge-wandering cycle with remainder and odd part, then subtract.

sentences.zh: 以天正恆朔小餘加閏餘，以減期總，餘為總實。

translations.literal: Add intercalary remainder to the mean new moon small remainder of the celestial first month and subtract from the period total—remainder is total constant.
translations.idiomatic: Add the intercalary remainder to the celestial first-month mean new-moon small remainder and subtract from the period total—the remainder is the total constant.

sentences.zh: 求恆弦望術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding fixed first, middle, and full moons
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the mean first quarter, full moon, and last quarter

sentences.zh: 因天正恆朔大小餘，加大餘十，小餘五百一十二太，凡四分一為少，二為半，三為太。

translations.literal: From the celestial first month mean new moon large and small remainders, add large remainder 10, small remainder 512 and a grand fraction—of four parts, one is minor, two is half, three is grand.
translations.idiomatic: From the celestial first-month mean new-moon large and small remainders, add 10 to the large remainder and 512 plus a major fraction to the small remainder—of four parts, one is minor, two is half, three is major.

sentences.zh: 滿法者，去命如前，即天正上弦恆日及大小餘。

translations.literal: When it fills the divisor, remove and assign names as before—that is the fixed day of first quarter for the celestial first month, with large and small remainders.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the divisor, discard the cycle and assign names as before—that gives the mean day of the first quarter for the celestial first month, with large and small remainders.

sentences.zh: 以次轉加，得望下弦及來月朔。

translations.literal: Add in turn to obtain full moon, last quarter, and the next month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding in sequence to obtain the full moon, last quarter, and the next month's new moon.

sentences.zh: 以次轉加，去命如前，合得所求。

translations.literal: Add in turn, remove and assign names as before—combine to obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding, discarding cycles and assigning names as before—together these yield the date sought.

sentences.zh: 他皆放此。

translations.literal: All other cases follow this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All other cases follow this pattern.

sentences.zh: 因朔徑求望，加大餘十四，小餘一百二十五分半。

translations.literal: From the new moon derive the full moon directly: add large remainder 14, small remainder 125 and a half fraction.
translations.idiomatic: To derive the full moon directly from the new moon: add 14 to the large remainder and 125 plus a half fraction to the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 因朔徑求下弦，加大餘二十二，小餘一百九十八少。

translations.literal: From the new moon derive the last quarter directly: add large remainder 22, small remainder 198 and a minor fraction.
translations.idiomatic: To derive the last quarter directly from the new moon: add 22 to the large remainder and 198 plus a minor fraction to the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 因朔徑次朔，加大餘二十九，小餘七百十一。

translations.literal: From the new moon derive the next new moon directly: add large remainder 29, small remainder 711.
translations.idiomatic: To derive the next new moon directly from the new moon: add 29 to the large remainder and 711 to the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 半總：六百七十。

translations.literal: Half common divisor: 670.
translations.idiomatic: Half common divisor: 670.

sentences.zh: 辰率：三百三十五。

translations.literal: Double-hour rate: 335.
translations.idiomatic: Double-hour rate: 335.

sentences.zh: 檢律候氣日術

translations.literal: Procedure for checking pitch-pipes against qi days
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for verifying pitch-pipe response days and the added double-hour

sentences.zh: 求恆氣初日影泛差術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the general difference of shadow length on the first day of fixed qi
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the provisional difference in gnomon shadow on the first day of a mean solar term

sentences.zh: 見所求氣陟降率，並後氣率，半之，十五而一，為泛末率。

translations.literal: Take the ascending-descending rate of the sought qi and the rate of the following qi, halve their sum, divide by fifteen—this is the general terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take the ascending or descending rate of the term sought and of the following term; average them and divide by fifteen—this is the provisional terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 又二率相減，餘，十五而一，為總差。

translations.literal: Also subtract the two rates; divide the remainder by fifteen—this is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the two rates; divide the difference by fifteen—this is the total difference.

sentences.zh: 前少，以總差減泛末率；

translations.literal: If the former is smaller, subtract the total difference from the general terminal rate;
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is smaller, subtract the total difference from the provisional terminal rate;

sentences.zh: 前多，以總差加泛末率。

translations.literal: if the former is larger, add the total difference to the general terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: if the earlier rate is larger, add the total difference to the provisional terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 加減泛末率訖，即為泛初率。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction to the general terminal rate are complete, this is the general initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: When adjustment of the provisional terminal rate is complete, the result is the provisional initial rate.

sentences.zh: 其後氣無同率，因前末率即為泛初率。

translations.literal: When the following qi has no matching rate, the preceding terminal rate becomes the general initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: When the following solar term has no corresponding rate, the preceding terminal rate serves as the provisional initial rate.

sentences.zh: 以總差減初率，餘為泛末率。

translations.literal: Subtract the initial rate by the total difference; remainder is the general terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the total difference from the initial rate; the remainder is the provisional terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 求恆氣初日影定差術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the fixed difference of shadow length on the first day of fixed qi
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed difference in gnomon shadow on the first day of a mean solar term

sentences.zh: 十五除總差，為別差為限。

translations.literal: Divide the total difference by fifteen—fixed difference becomes the limit.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the total difference by fifteen—the quotient is the interval difference used as the limit.

sentences.zh: 前少者，以限差加泛初末率；

translations.literal: If the former is smaller, add the limit-difference to the general initial and terminal rates;
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is smaller, add the interval difference to the provisional initial and terminal rates;

sentences.zh: 前多者，以限差減泛初末率。

translations.literal: if the former is larger, subtract the limit-difference from the general initial and terminal rates.
translations.idiomatic: if the earlier rate is larger, subtract the interval difference from the provisional initial and terminal rates.

sentences.zh: 加減泛初末率訖，即為定初末率，即恆氣初日影定差。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction to the general initial and terminal rates are complete, these are the fixed initial and terminal rates—the fixed difference of shadow on the first day of fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: When adjustment is complete, these are the fixed initial and terminal rates—the fixed shadow difference for the first day of the mean solar term.

sentences.zh: 求次日影差術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the next day's shadow difference
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the next day's shadow difference

sentences.zh: 以別定差，前少者加初日影定差，前多者減初日影定差。

translations.literal: With the separate fixed difference: if the former is smaller, add to the first-day fixed shadow difference; if larger, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Using the separate fixed difference: if the earlier rate is smaller, add it to the first-day fixed shadow difference; if larger, subtract it.

sentences.zh: 加減初日影定差訖，即為次日影定差。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction to the first-day fixed shadow difference are complete, that is the next day's fixed shadow difference.
translations.idiomatic: When this adjustment is complete, the result is the next day's fixed shadow difference.

sentences.zh: 以次積累歲，即各得所求。

translations.literal: Accumulate in turn for each day—each yields what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate day by day in sequence—each step yields the value sought.

sentences.zh: 每氣皆十五日為限。

translations.literal: Each qi has a limit of fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Each solar term spans a limit of fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 其有皆以十六除取泛末率及總差別差。

translations.literal: Where all use division by sixteen to obtain general terminal rate and total and separate differences.
translations.idiomatic: Cases that use division by sixteen instead to obtain the provisional terminal rate and the total and separate differences.

sentences.zh: 求恆氣日中影定數術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the fixed number of midday shadow for fixed qi
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed midday gnomon shadow for a mean solar term

sentences.zh: 置其恆氣小餘，以半總減之，餘為中後分。

translations.literal: Set the small remainder of that fixed qi; subtract half the common divisor—remainder is post-midday fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Set the small remainder of that mean solar term; subtract half the common divisor—the remainder is the post-midday fraction.

sentences.zh: 不足減者反減半總，餘為中前分。

translations.literal: When insufficient to subtract, reverse-subtract from half common divisor—remainder is pre-midday fraction.
translations.idiomatic: When it cannot be subtracted, subtract from half the common divisor instead—the remainder is the pre-midday fraction.

sentences.zh: 置前後分，影定差乘之，總法而一，為變差。

translations.literal: Set the before and after fractions; multiply by the fixed shadow difference, divide by common divisor—one is variable difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the pre- and post-midday fractions; multiply by the fixed shadow difference and divide by the common divisor—the quotient is the variable difference.

sentences.zh: 冬至後，午前以變差減氣影，午後以變差加氣影。

translations.literal: After winter solstice, before noon subtract the variable difference from the qi shadow; after noon add it.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice, before noon subtract the variable difference from the term's shadow; after noon add it.

sentences.zh: 夏至後，午前以變差加氣影，午後以變差減氣影。

translations.literal: After summer solstice, before noon add the variable difference; after noon subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: After the summer solstice, before noon add the variable difference; after noon subtract it.

sentences.zh: 冬至一日，有減無加。

translations.literal: On winter solstice day there is subtraction but no addition.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice day there is only subtraction, never addition.

sentences.zh: 夏至一日，有加無減。

translations.literal: On summer solstice day there is addition but no subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: On the summer solstice day there is only addition, never subtraction.

sentences.zh: 加減訖，各其恆氣日中定影。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction are complete, each has the fixed midday shadow for its fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: When adjustment is complete, each term has its fixed midday gnomon shadow.

sentences.zh: 求次日中影術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the next day's midday shadow
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the next day's midday shadow

sentences.zh: 迭以定差陟減降加恆氣日中定影，各得次日中影。

translations.literal: In successive steps add or subtract ascending-descending by the fixed difference to the fixed midday shadow of fixed qi—each yields the next day's midday shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Step by step, add or subtract the fixed difference according to whether the rate ascends or descends from the mean term's fixed midday shadow—each step yields the next day's midday shadow.

sentences.zh: 後漢及魏宋曆，冬至日中影一丈二尺，夏至一尺五寸，於今並短。

translations.literal: In Later Han and Wei-Song calendars, the winter solstice midday shadow was twelve feet and summer solstice one foot five inches—both are now shorter than current measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the calendars of Later Han and of Wei and Song, the winter solstice midday shadow was twelve feet and the summer solstice shadow one foot five inches—both are shorter than present-day measurements.

sentences.zh: 各須隨時影校其陟降，及氣日中影應二至率。

translations.literal: Each must adjust its ascents and descents against timely shadow readings, and the midday shadow of qi should match the two solstice rates.
translations.idiomatic: Each calendar must adjust its ascending and descending rates against shadows measured at the proper season, so that the midday shadow at each term matches the solstice rates.

sentences.zh: 他皆仿此。

translations.literal: All other cases model this.
translations.idiomatic: All other cases follow this model.

sentences.zh: 前求每日中影術，古曆並無，臣等創立斯法也。

translations.literal: The earlier procedure for finding each day's midday shadow—ancient calendars had none; your ministers established this method anew.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier procedure for finding each day's midday shadow—no ancient calendar had it; we, your ministers, devised this method anew.

sentences.zh: 求律呂應日及加時術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the days when pitch-pipes respond and the added double-hour
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the days when pitch-pipes respond and the added double-hour

sentences.zh: 十二律各以其月恆中氣日加時，應列其氣小餘，六乘之，辰率而一，為半總之數，不盡，為辰餘。

translations.literal: Each of the twelve pitch-pipes takes its month's fixed central-qi day and added double-hour; set out that qi's small remainder, multiply by six, divide by double-hour rate—one is the number of half common divisors; what does not fill is double-hour remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the twelve pitch-pipes corresponds to the added double-hour of its month's mean central solar term; set out that term's small remainder, multiply by six, and divide by the double-hour rate—the quotient counts half common divisors; the remainder is the double-hour remainder.

sentences.zh: 命時起子算半，為加時所在辰。

translations.literal: From the double-hour begin counting from zi at the half-point—that is the double-hour in which the addition falls.
translations.idiomatic: From the double-hour, begin counting from zi at the half-interval—that is the double-hour of the added moment.

sentences.zh: 六乘辰餘，如法得一為初，二為少弱，三為少，四為少強，五為半弱。

translations.literal: Multiply the double-hour remainder by six; when it fills the divisor, one is initial, two is minor-weak, three is minor, four is minor-strong, five is half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the double-hour remainder by six; when it fills the divisor, one counts as initial, two as minor-weak, three as minor, four as minor-strong, five as half-weak.

sentences.zh: 若在辰半後者，得一為半強，二為太弱，三為太，四為太強，五為辰末。

translations.literal: If after the middle of the double-hour, one is half-strong, two is major-weak, three is major, four is major-strong, five is end of double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: If the moment falls after the middle of the double-hour, one counts as half-strong, two as major-weak, three as major, four as major-strong, five as the end of the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求七十二候術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the seventy-two hou
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the seventy-two pentads

sentences.zh: 恆氣日，即初候日也。

translations.literal: The fixed-qi day is the day of the first hou.
translations.idiomatic: The mean solar-term day is the day of the first pentad.

sentences.zh: 加其大餘五，小餘九十七，小分十一。

translations.literal: Add to its large remainder 5, to small remainder 97, and to small fraction 11.
translations.idiomatic: Add 5 to its large remainder, 97 to the small remainder, and 11 to the minor fraction.

sentences.zh: 三乘氣小分加十一，滿十八從小餘一。

translations.literal: Multiply the qi's small fraction by three and add 11; when it reaches 18, carry one to the small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the solar term's minor fraction by three and add 11; when the total reaches 18, carry one to the small remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿法，去命如前，即次候日。

translations.literal: When it fills the divisor, remove and assign names as before—that is the day of the next hou.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the divisor, discard the cycle and assign names as before—that gives the next pentad day.

sentences.zh: 以次轉加，得末候日。

translations.literal: Add in turn to obtain the day of the final hou.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding in sequence to obtain the day of the final pentad.

sentences.zh: 求次氣日檢盈虛術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the next qi day and checking excess and deficiency
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the next solar-term day and verifying excess and deficiency

sentences.zh: 進綱一十六退紀一十七

translations.literal: Advance guideline 16, retreat cycle 17
translations.idiomatic: Advance guideline: 16; retreat cycle: 17

sentences.zh: 泛差一十一總辰一十二六十並平闕

translations.literal: General difference 11, total double-hours 12, sixty combined with mean gap
translations.idiomatic: General difference: 11; total double-hours: 12; sixty combined with mean shortfall

sentences.zh: 秋分後春分前日行速，春分後秋分前日行遲。

translations.literal: After the autumn equinox and before the spring equinox the sun's daily motion is fast; after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox it is slow.
translations.idiomatic: After the autumn equinox and before the spring equinox the sun's daily motion is fast; after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox it is slow.

sentences.zh: 速為進綱，遲為退紀。

translations.literal: Fast is advance guideline; slow is retreat cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Fast motion is advance guideline; slow motion is retreat cycle.

sentences.zh: 若取其數，綱為名；

translations.literal: If one takes their numbers, the guideline is the name;
translations.idiomatic: When taking their numbers, the guideline serves as the name;

sentences.zh: 用其時，春分為至。

translations.literal: when using their seasons, the spring equinox is the solstice.
translations.idiomatic: when applying their seasons, the spring equinox marks the turning point.

sentences.zh: 進日分前，退日分後。

translations.literal: Advance before the day-fraction; retreat after the day-fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Advance before the day-fraction; retreat after the day-fraction.

sentences.zh: 凡用綱紀，皆准此例。

translations.literal: In general when using guidelines and cycles, all follow this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: In general, all uses of guidelines and cycles follow this pattern.

sentences.zh: 見所在氣躔差率，並後氣率，半之，總辰乘之，綱紀而一，得氣末率。

translations.literal: Take the lodge-difference rate of the qi in question and the rate of the following qi, halve their sum, multiply by total double-hours, divide by guideline and cycle—this yields the terminal rate of the qi.
translations.idiomatic: Take the lodge-difference rate of the term in question and of the following term; average them, multiply by the total double-hours, and divide by guideline and cycle—this yields the term's terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 各以泛差通其綱紀，以同差辰也。

translations.literal: Each applies the general difference through its guideline and cycle to obtain the same difference in double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: Each applies the general difference through its guideline and cycle to align the double-hour differences.

sentences.zh: 又二率相減，餘以總辰乘而紀除之，為總差。

translations.literal: Also subtract the two rates; multiply the remainder by total double-hours and divide by cycle—this is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the two rates; multiply the difference by the total double-hours and divide by the cycle—this is the total difference.

sentences.zh: 辰之綱紀除之，為別差率。

translations.literal: Divide by the double-hour guideline and cycle—this is the separate difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the double-hour guideline and cycle—this is the separate difference rate.

sentences.zh: 前少者，以總差減末率；

translations.literal: If the former is smaller, subtract the total difference from the terminal rate;
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is smaller, subtract the total difference from the terminal rate;

sentences.zh: 前多者，以總差加末率。

translations.literal: if the former is larger, add the total difference to the terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: if the earlier rate is larger, add the total difference to the terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 加減訖，皆為其氣初日損益率。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction are complete, each is the gain-loss rate for the first day of its qi.
translations.idiomatic: When adjustment is complete, each is the gain-loss rate for the first day of that solar term.

sentences.zh: 前多者，以別差率減；

translations.literal: If the former is larger, subtract the separate difference rate;
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is larger, subtract the separate difference rate;

sentences.zh: 前少者，以別差率加。

translations.literal: if the former is smaller, add the separate difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: if the earlier rate is smaller, add the separate difference rate.

sentences.zh: 加減氣初日損益率訖，即次日損益率。

translations.literal: When the first-day gain-loss rate of the qi has been adjusted, that is the next day's gain-loss rate.
translations.idiomatic: When the solar term's first-day gain-loss rate has been adjusted, the result is the next day's gain-loss rate.

sentences.zh: 亦名每日躔差率。

translations.literal: Also called the daily lodge-difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: This is also called the daily lodge-difference rate.

sentences.zh: 以次加減，得每日所求。

translations.literal: Add and subtract in turn to obtain what is sought for each day.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding and subtracting in sequence to obtain the value for each day.

sentences.zh: 各累所損益，隨曆定氣損益消息總，各為其日消息數。

translations.literal: Accumulate the gains and losses; following the fixed qi, the total of gain-loss messages for each is the daily message number.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the gains and losses; following the mean solar terms, the running total of gain-loss messages for each day is that day's message number.

sentences.zh: 其後氣無同率，及有數同者，皆因前少，以前末率為初率，加總差為末率，別差漸加初率，為每日率。

translations.literal: When the following qi has no matching rate, or when numbers match, if the former is smaller take the preceding terminal rate as initial rate, add total difference for terminal rate, and gradually add separate difference to initial rate for the daily rate.
translations.idiomatic: When the following term has no matching rate, or when rates coincide, if the earlier rate is smaller take the preceding terminal rate as the initial rate, add the total difference for the terminal rate, and gradually add the separate difference to the initial rate to obtain the daily rate.

sentences.zh: 前多者，總差減初率為末率，別差漸減為日率。

translations.literal: If the former is larger, subtract total difference from initial rate for terminal rate; gradually subtract separate difference for daily rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is larger, subtract the total difference from the initial rate to obtain the terminal rate; gradually subtract the separate difference to obtain the daily rate.

sentences.zh: 其有氣初末計會及綱紀所校多少不葉者，隨其增損調而禦之，使際會相准。

translations.literal: When the initial and terminal counts of a qi do not agree with what guideline and cycle would require, adjust gains and losses until the junctions align.
translations.idiomatic: When a term's initial and terminal reckonings do not match what the guideline and cycle require, adjust gains and losses until the junctions align.

sentences.zh: 求氣盈朒所入日辰術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the day and double-hour entered by qi excess and deficiency
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the day and double-hour entered by solar-term excess and deficiency

sentences.zh: 冬夏二至，即以恆氣為定。

translations.literal: For the winter and summer solstices, take the fixed qi as definitive.
translations.idiomatic: For the winter and summer solstices, take the mean solar term as definitive.

sentences.zh: 自外，各以氣下消息數，息減消加其恆氣小餘，滿若不足，進退其日。

translations.literal: For all others, take the message number below the qi; where it is rest, subtract and where it is motion, add to the fixed qi small remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day.
translations.idiomatic: For all other terms, take the message number below the term; where it indicates rest, subtract, and where it indicates motion, add to the mean solar term's small remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day.

sentences.zh: 即其氣朒日辰。

translations.literal: That is the day and double-hour of the qi's deficiency.
translations.idiomatic: That gives the true day and double-hour of the solar term.

sentences.zh: 亦因別其日，命以甲子，得所求。

translations.literal: Also distinguish its day and assign names from jiazi to obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Also determine its day and assign stem-branch names from jiazi to obtain the date sought.

sentences.zh: 加之為盈氣，減之為朒氣，定其盈朒所在，故日定。

translations.literal: Addition yields excess qi; subtraction yields deficient qi—fix where excess and deficiency lie, hence the day is definitive.
translations.idiomatic: Addition yields an excess term; subtraction yields a deficient term—fix where the excess or deficiency falls, and the day is thereby determined.

sentences.zh: 凡推日月度及推發斂，皆依定氣推之。

translations.literal: In general, when deriving solar and lunar degrees and when deriving waxing and waning, all rely on fixed qi for derivation.
translations.idiomatic: In general, when computing solar and lunar positions and when computing waxing and waning, all calculations rely on true solar terms.

sentences.zh: 若注曆，依恆氣日。

translations.literal: If annotating the calendar, use fixed-qi days.
translations.idiomatic: If annotating the calendar, use mean solar-term days.

sentences.zh: 求定氣恆朔弦望夜半後辰數術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the number of double-hours after midnight for fixed qi, fixed new moon, and fixed first, middle, and full moons
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding double-hours after midnight for true solar terms, true new moons, and true quarters and full moons

sentences.zh: 各置其小餘，三乘，如辰率而一，為夜半後辰數。

translations.literal: Set each small remainder; multiply by three; divide by double-hour rate—one is the number of double-hours after midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Set each small remainder; multiply by three; divide by the double-hour rate—the quotient is the number of double-hours after midnight.

sentences.zh: 求每日盈朒積術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the daily accumulated excess and deficiency
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the daily accumulated excess and deficiency

sentences.zh: 各置其氣先後率與盈朒積，乃以先率後率加躔差率，盈朒積加消息總，亦如求消息法，即得每日所入盈朒及先後之數。

translations.literal: Set each qi's early and late rates with excess-deficiency accumulation; then add lodge-difference rate to early and late rates and add message total to excess-deficiency accumulation, also as in the message method—this yields the daily entered excess-deficiency and early-late numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Set each term's early and late rates with its excess-deficiency accumulation; then add the lodge-difference rate to the early and late rates and add the message total to the excess-deficiency accumulation, using the same method as for messages—this yields the daily entered excess-deficiency and early-late numbers.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望恆日恆所入盈縮數術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the mean-day mean entered excess and contraction numbers for new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the mean entered excess and contraction numbers for new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter on mean days

sentences.zh: 各以總辰乘其所入定氣日，算朒朔弦望夜半後辰數，乃以所入定氣夜半後辰數減之，餘為辰總。

translations.literal: Each multiplies the entered fixed-qi day by total double-hours and computes the new-moon, first-quarter, full-moon, and last-quarter double-hours after midnight; then subtract the entered fixed-qi double-hours after midnight—remainder is double-hour total.
translations.idiomatic: For each, multiply the entered true solar-term day by the total double-hours and compute the double-hours after midnight for new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter; then subtract the entered true solar term's double-hours after midnight—the remainder is the double-hour total.

sentences.zh: 其恆朔弦望與定氣同日而辰多者，其朔弦望即在前氣氣末，而辰總時有多於進綱紀通數者，疑入後氣之初也。

translations.literal: When mean new moon, first quarter, full moon, or last quarter falls on the same day as fixed qi but with more double-hours, the new moon or quarter lies at the end of the preceding qi; when double-hour total exceeds the advance guideline and cycle common number, it may enter the beginning of the following qi.
translations.idiomatic: When a mean new moon or quarter falls on the same day as a true solar term but with more double-hours, the new moon or quarter lies at the end of the preceding term; when the double-hour total exceeds the advance guideline and cycle common number, it may enter the beginning of the following term.

sentences.zh: 以乘其氣前多之末率、前少之初率，總辰而一，為總率。

translations.literal: Multiply the terminal rate when the former is larger or the initial rate when the former is smaller; divide by total double-hours—one is total rate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the terminal rate if the earlier rate is larger, or the initial rate if the earlier rate is smaller; divide by the total double-hours—the quotient is the total rate.

sentences.zh: 凡須相乘有分餘者，母必通全子乘訖報母，異者齊同也。

translations.literal: Whenever multiplication involves fractional remainders, the denominator must be made common, the child multiplied, then reported to the mother; when denominators differ, make them equal.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever multiplication involves fractional remainders, reduce to a common denominator, multiply the numerators, then report to the denominator; when denominators differ, reduce them to a common measure.

sentences.zh: 其前多者，辰總減紀乘總差，綱紀而一，為差。

translations.literal: If the former is larger, subtract from double-hour total the cycle-multiplied total difference; divide by guideline and cycle—one is difference.
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is larger, subtract the cycle-multiplied total difference from the double-hour total; divide by guideline and cycle—the quotient is the difference.

sentences.zh: 並於總率差，辰總乘之，倍總辰除之，以加總率。

translations.literal: Add to total-rate difference; multiply by double-hour total; divide by twice the total double-hours; add to total rate.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the total-rate difference; multiply by the double-hour total; divide by twice the total double-hours; add to the total rate.

sentences.zh: 前少者，辰總再乘別差，總辰自辰乘，倍而除之，以加總率，皆為總數。

translations.literal: If the former is smaller, multiply double-hour total again by separate difference, multiply by total double-hours from the double-hour itself, double and divide; add to total rate—all are total numbers.
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is smaller, multiply the double-hour total again by the separate difference, multiply by the total double-hours from the double-hour itself, double and divide; add to the total rate—these are all total numbers.

sentences.zh: 乃以先加後減其氣盈朒為定積，凡分餘不成全而更不復須者，過半更不後夜無氣也。

translations.literal: Then add or subtract later and subtract earlier to the qi's excess-deficiency for fixed accumulation; whenever fractional remainders do not form wholes and need not be continued, if more than half do not carry to the following night without qi.
translations.idiomatic: Then apply later-addition and earlier-subtraction to the term's excess-deficiency to obtain the fixed accumulation; whenever fractional remainders do not form wholes and need not be continued, if more than half, do not carry to the following night without a term.

sentences.zh: 以盈朒定積，盈加朒減其日小餘，滿若不足，進退之，各其入盈朒日及小餘。

translations.literal: With excess-deficiency fixed accumulation, add for excess and subtract for deficiency from the day's small remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat—each yields the entered excess-deficiency day and small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: With the excess-deficiency fixed accumulation, add for excess and subtract for deficiency from the day's small remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat—each yields the entered excess-deficiency day and small remainder.

sentences.zh: 若非朔望有交從者速粗舉者，以所入定氣日算乘先後率，加十五而一，先加減盈朒為定積。

translations.literal: If not new moon or full moon with eclipse and one wishes a rough quick reckoning, multiply the entered fixed-qi day by the early-late rate, add and divide by fifteen—first add or subtract excess-deficiency for fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: If not a new moon or full moon with an eclipse and one wants a rough quick reckoning, multiply the entered true solar-term day by the early-late rate, add, and divide by fifteen—first add or subtract excess-deficiency for the fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 入氣日十五算者，加十六而一。

translations.literal: For days entering qi counted as fifteen, add and divide by sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: For days entering a term counted as fifteen, add and divide by sixteen.

sentences.zh: 曆變周：四十四萬三千七十七。

translations.literal: Calendar change cycle: 443,077.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar change cycle: 443,077.

sentences.zh: 變奇率：十二。

translations.literal: Change odd rate: 12.
translations.idiomatic: Change odd rate: 12.

sentences.zh: 曆變日：二十七；

translations.literal: Calendar change day: 27;
translations.idiomatic: Calendar change day: 27;

sentences.zh: 變餘，七百四十三；

translations.literal: change remainder, 743;
translations.idiomatic: change remainder, 743;

sentences.zh: 變奇，一。

translations.literal: change odd, 1.
translations.idiomatic: change odd, 1.

sentences.zh: 月程法：六十三。

translations.literal: Lunar circuit divisor: 63.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar circuit divisor: 63.

sentences.zh: 推曆變術

translations.literal: Procedure for deriving calendar change
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for deriving calendar change

sentences.zh: 以曆變周去總實，餘，以變奇率乘之，滿變周又去之。

translations.literal: Remove calendar change cycle from total constant; multiply remainder by change odd rate; when it fills change cycle, remove again.
translations.idiomatic: Remove the calendar change cycle from the total constant; multiply the remainder by the change odd rate; when it fills the change cycle, remove again.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，變奇率約之，為變分。

translations.literal: What does not fill is reduced by change odd rate to change fraction.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill is reduced by the change odd rate to a change fraction.

sentences.zh: 不盡，為變奇。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is change odd.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted is the change odd.

sentences.zh: 分滿總法為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: When fraction fills common divisor, one is day; what does not fill is remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the fraction fills the common divisor, that counts as one day; the remainder is what does not fill.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，即所求年天正恆朔夜半入變日及餘，以天正恆朔小餘加之，即經辰所入。

translations.literal: Count days outside the calculation—that is the change day and remainder entered at midnight of the celestial first-month mean new moon for the year sought; add the celestial first-month mean new moon small remainder—that is the lodge entered.
translations.idiomatic: Count days outside the reckoning—that gives the change day and remainder entered at midnight of the celestial first-month mean new moon for the year sought; add the celestial first-month mean new-moon small remainder—that is the lodge entered.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望經辰所入

translations.literal: Finding the lodge entered at new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter
translations.idiomatic: Finding the lodge entered at new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter

sentences.zh: 因天正經辰所入日餘奇，加日七、餘五百一十二、奇九。

translations.literal: From the celestial first month's entered day, remainder, and odd of the lodge at midnight, add day 7, remainder 512, odd 9.
translations.idiomatic: From the celestial first month's lodge day, remainder, and odd entered at midnight, add 7 days, remainder 512, and odd 9.

sentences.zh: 奇滿率成餘。

translations.literal: When odd fills rate, it becomes remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the odd fills the rate, it becomes remainder.

sentences.zh: 餘，如總法為日，得上弦經辰所入。

translations.literal: Remainder: when like common divisor, one is day—this yields the lodge entered at first quarter.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder: when it matches the common divisor, that counts as one day—this yields the lodge entered at the first quarter.

sentences.zh: 以次轉加，得望、下弦及來月朔。

translations.literal: Add in turn to obtain full moon, last quarter, and next month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding in sequence to obtain the full moon, last quarter, and the next month's new moon.

sentences.zh: 所入滿變日及餘奇，則去之。

translations.literal: When entered fills change day and remainder odd, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When the entered value fills the change day, remainder, and odd, discard them.

sentences.zh: 凡相連去者，皆仿於此。

translations.literal: All successive removals follow this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All successive removals follow this pattern.

sentences.zh: 徑求望者，加朔所入日十四、餘一千二十五、奇六。

translations.literal: To derive full moon directly, add to new moon entered day 14, remainder 1,025, odd 6.
translations.idiomatic: To derive the full moon directly, add to the new moon's entered day 14, remainder 1,025, and odd 6.

sentences.zh: 徑求次朔，加一日、餘一千三百七、奇十一。

translations.literal: To derive next new moon directly, add one day, remainder 1,307, odd 11.
translations.idiomatic: To derive the next new moon directly, add one day, remainder 1,307, and odd 11.

sentences.zh: 求朔望弦盈朒減辰所入術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding entered day and double-hour of new moon, full moon, and quarters with excess-deficiency reduction
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the entered day and double-hour of new moon, full moon, and quarters with excess-deficiency adjustment

sentences.zh: 各以其日所入盈朒定積，盈加朒減其恆經辰所入，餘即各所求。

translations.literal: Each takes that day's entered excess-deficiency fixed accumulation; add for excess and subtract for deficiency from the mean lodge entered—remainder is what is sought for each.
translations.idiomatic: Each takes that day's entered excess-deficiency fixed accumulation; add for excess and subtract for deficiency from the mean lodge entered—the remainder is the value sought for each.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望盈朒日辰入變遲速定數術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the fixed number of change slow-fast for entered day and double-hour of new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter with excess-deficiency
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed change slow-fast number for the entered day and double-hour of new moon, quarters, and full moon with excess-deficiency

sentences.zh: 各列其所入日增減率，並後率而半之，為通率。

translations.literal: List each entered day's increase-decrease rate; add to the following rate and halve—this is common rate.
translations.idiomatic: List each entered day's increase-decrease rate; add it to the following rate and halve—the result is the common rate.

sentences.zh: 又二率相減，餘為率差。

translations.literal: Also subtract the two rates—remainder is rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the two rates—the difference is the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 增者，以入餘減總法，餘乘率差，總法而一，並率差而半之。

translations.literal: For increase, subtract entered remainder from common divisor; multiply remainder by rate difference; divide by common divisor and halve with rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: For increase, subtract the entered remainder from the common divisor; multiply the remainder by the rate difference; divide by the common divisor and halve together with the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 減者，半入餘乘率差，亦總法而一，並以加於通率，入餘乘之，總法而一，所得為經辰變轉半經辰變。

translations.literal: For decrease, halve entered remainder multiplied by rate difference, also divide by common divisor and add to common rate; multiply entered remainder and divide by common divisor—the result is lodge change at turn and half lodge change at turn.
translations.idiomatic: For decrease, halve the entered remainder multiplied by the rate difference, also divide by the common divisor and add to the common rate; multiply the entered remainder and divide by the common divisor—the result is lodge change at the turn and half lodge change at the turn.

sentences.zh: 速減遲加盈朒經辰所入餘，為轉餘。

translations.literal: Fast subtracts and slow adds to excess-deficiency lodge entered remainder—this is turn remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Fast subtracts and slow adds to the excess-deficiency lodge entered remainder—this is the turn remainder.

sentences.zh: 應增者，減法。

translations.literal: Where increase is required, subtract from divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Where increase is required, subtract from the divisor.

sentences.zh: 應減者，因餘。

translations.literal: Where decrease is required, use remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Where decrease is required, use the remainder.

sentences.zh: 皆以乘率差，總法而一，加於通率。

translations.literal: All multiply by rate difference, divide by common divisor, and add to common rate.
translations.idiomatic: In all cases multiply by the rate difference, divide by the common divisor, and add to the common rate.

sentences.zh: 變率乘之，總法而一，以速減遲加變率為定率。

translations.literal: Multiply by change rate, divide by common divisor; subtract fast and add slow to change rate for fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the change rate and divide by the common divisor; subtract fast and add slow to the change rate to obtain the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 乃以定率增減遲速積為定。

translations.literal: Then with fixed rate increase or decrease the slow-fast accumulation to fix it.
translations.idiomatic: Then use the fixed rate to increase or decrease the slow-fast accumulation to obtain the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 此法微密至當，以示算理通途。

translations.literal: This method is minute and exact to the point, showing the thoroughfare of computational principle.
translations.idiomatic: This method is minute and exact throughout, showing the thoroughfare of computational principle.

sentences.zh: 若非朔望有交及欲考校速要者，但以入餘乘增減率，總法而一，增減速為要耳。

translations.literal: If not new moon or full moon with eclipse and one wishes to examine or verify quickly, simply multiply entered remainder by increase-decrease rate, divide by common divisor, and increase or decrease slow—that suffices.
translations.idiomatic: If not a new moon or full moon with an eclipse and one wishes to examine or verify quickly, simply multiply the entered remainder by the increase-decrease rate, divide by the common divisor, and adjust slow—that suffices.

sentences.zh: 其後無同率者，亦因前率，應增者以通率為初數，半率差而減之；

translations.literal: When the following has no matching rate, also follow the preceding rate; where increase is required take common rate as initial number and subtract half rate difference;
translations.idiomatic: When the following term has no matching rate, also follow the preceding rate; where increase is required, take the common rate as the initial number and subtract half the rate difference;

sentences.zh: 應減入餘進退日者分為二日，隨餘初末，如法求之。

translations.literal: where decrease requires advancing or retreating the day from entered remainder, split into two days and seek according to remainder initial or terminal.
translations.idiomatic: where decrease requires advancing or retreating the day from the entered remainder, split into two days and compute according to whether the remainder is initial or terminal.

sentences.zh: 所得並以加減變率為定。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the results to change rate to fix it.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the results to the change rate to obtain the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 其入前件日餘，如初數已下者為初，已上者以初數減總法，餘為末之數。

translations.literal: For entered remainder in the preceding item's day, if below initial number it is initial; if above, subtract initial number from common divisor—remainder is terminal number.
translations.idiomatic: For the entered remainder on the preceding item's day, if below the initial number it is initial; if above, subtract the initial number from the common divisor—the remainder is the terminal number.

sentences.zh: 增減相反，約以九分為限。

translations.literal: Increase and decrease are opposite; approximate with nine parts as limit.
translations.idiomatic: Increase and decrease are opposite; approximate with nine-ninths as the limit.

sentences.zh: 初雖少弱，而末微強，餘差不多，理況兼舉，皆今有雜差，各隨其數。

translations.literal: Though initial is slightly weak, terminal is slightly strong; remainders are nearly equal—reason suggests both be taken, yet now there are mixed differences, each following its number.
translations.idiomatic: Though the initial value is slightly weak and the terminal slightly strong, the remainders are nearly equal—reason suggests taking both, yet now there are mixed differences, each following its number.

sentences.zh: 若恆算所求，七日與二十一日得初率，而末之所減，隱而不顯。

translations.literal: If by fixed calculation one seeks, on days seven and twenty-one one obtains initial rate, while what terminal subtracts is hidden and not displayed.
translations.idiomatic: If by mean calculation one seeks, on the seventh and twenty-first days one obtains the initial rate, while what the terminal subtracts remains hidden and not displayed.

sentences.zh: 且數與平行正算，亦初末有數，而恆算所無。

translations.literal: Moreover, the numbers used in parallel regular calculation also have initial and terminal numbers, which mean calculation lacks.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the numbers used in parallel regular calculation also have initial and terminal values, which mean calculation does not provide.

sentences.zh: 其十四日、二十八日既初末數存，而虛差亦減其數，數當去恆法不見。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth and twenty-eighth days, since initial and terminal numbers remain, the spurious difference also reduces those numbers—the numbers should be removed from the mean divisor and not appear.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth and twenty-eighth days, since initial and terminal numbers remain, the spurious difference also reduces those numbers—the numbers should be dropped from the mean divisor and not appear.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望盈朒所入日名及小餘術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the entered day name and small remainder of excess-deficiency for new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the entered day name and small remainder of excess-deficiency for new moon, quarters, and full moon

sentences.zh: 各以其所入變曆速定數速減遲加其盈朒小餘。

translations.literal: Each takes the fixed change slow-fast number of the entered change cycle—fast subtracts and slow adds to its excess-deficiency small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Each takes the fixed change slow-fast number of the entered change cycle—fast subtracts and slow adds to its excess-deficiency small remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿若不足，進退其日。

translations.literal: When full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day.
translations.idiomatic: When full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day.

sentences.zh: 命以甲子算外，各其盈朒日反餘。

translations.literal: Assign from jiazi beyond the count; for each, the reversed remainder of the excess-deficiency day.
translations.idiomatic: Assign from jiazi beyond the count; for each, take the reversed remainder of the excess-deficiency day.

sentences.zh: 加其恆日，餘者為盈；

translations.literal: Add to its mean day—the remainder is excess;
translations.idiomatic: Add to its mean day—the remainder is excess;

sentences.zh: 減其恆日，餘者為朒。

translations.literal: Subtract its mean day—the remainder is deficiency.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract its mean day—the remainder is deficiency.

sentences.zh: 其日不動者，依恆朔日而定其小餘，推擬日月行度。

translations.literal: Where the day does not move, fix the small remainder according to the mean new-moon day and derive the Sun's and Moon's motions in degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Where the day does not move, fix the small remainder according to the mean new-moon day and derive the solar and lunar motions in degrees.

sentences.zh: 其定小餘二十四已下，一千三百一十六已上者，其入氣盈朒、入曆遲速，皆須覆依本術推算，不得從粗舉速要之限。

translations.literal: When the fixed small remainder is twenty-four or below, or thirteen hundred sixteen or above, the entered-qi excess-deficiency and entered-cycle slow-fast all require recalculation by the original procedure—they must not follow the rough shortcut limit for speed.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed small remainder is twenty-four or below, or thirteen hundred sixteen or above, the entered-qi excess-deficiency and entered-cycle slow-fast all require recalculation by the original procedure—they must not follow the rough shortcut for speed.

sentences.zh: 乃前朔後朔，迭相推校。

translations.literal: Then compare the preceding new moon with the following new moon in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Then compare the preceding new moon with the following new moon in turn.

sentences.zh: 盈朒之課，據實為准。

translations.literal: The reckoning of excess and deficiency takes actuality as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: The reckoning of excess and deficiency takes actuality as the standard.

sentences.zh: 損不侵朒，益不過盈。

translations.literal: Reduction must not encroach on deficiency; increase must not exceed excess.
translations.idiomatic: Reduction must not encroach on deficiency; increase must not exceed excess.

sentences.zh: 求定朔月大小術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding whether the month of the fixed new moon is long or short
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding whether the month of the fixed new moon is long or short

sentences.zh: 凡朔盈朒日名，即為定朔日名。

translations.literal: In general the day name of the new-moon excess-deficiency is the fixed new-moon day name.
translations.idiomatic: In general the day name of the new-moon excess-deficiency is the fixed new-moon day name.

sentences.zh: 其定朔日名，十幹與來月同者大，不同者小。

translations.literal: For the fixed new-moon day name, if the ten stem matches the coming month it is long; if not, short.
translations.idiomatic: For the fixed new-moon day name, if the ten stem matches the coming month the month is long; if not, it is short.

sentences.zh: 其月無中氣者為閏月。

translations.literal: A month without mid-qi is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: A month without mid-qi is an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 其正月朔有定加時正月者，消息前後各一兩月，以定月之大小。

translations.literal: When the first-month new moon has a fixed addition falling in first month, adjust one or two months before and after to fix whether the month is long or short.
translations.idiomatic: When the first-month new moon has a fixed addition falling in first month, adjust one or two months before and after to determine whether the month is long or short.

sentences.zh: 合虧在晦二者，弦望亦隨事消息。

translations.literal: When conjunction and eclipse both fall on the last day of the month, the quarters and full moon are also adjusted as the case requires.
translations.idiomatic: When conjunction and eclipse both fall on the last day of the month, the quarters and full moon are also adjusted as the case requires.

sentences.zh: 凡置月朔，盈朒之極，不過頻三。

translations.literal: In general when setting monthly new moons, the extreme of excess and deficiency does not exceed three in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In general when setting monthly new moons, the extreme of excess and deficiency does not exceed three in succession.

sentences.zh: 其或過者，觀定小餘近夜半者量之。

translations.literal: If it exceeds this, observe whether the fixed small remainder is near midnight and measure accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: If it exceeds this, observe whether the fixed small remainder is near midnight and measure accordingly.

sentences.zh: 檢宿度術

translations.literal: Procedure for checking lodge degrees
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for checking lodge degrees

sentences.zh: 前件周天二十八宿，相距三百六十五度，前漢唐都以渾儀赤道所量。

translations.literal: The above twenty-eight lodges of the circuit of heaven, spaced at three hundred sixty-five degrees, were measured on the equatorial armillary sphere in Former Han and Tang capitals.
translations.idiomatic: The above twenty-eight lodges of the circuit of heaven, spaced at three hundred sixty-five degrees, were measured on the equatorial armillary sphere in Former Han and the Tang capitals.

sentences.zh: 其數常定，紘帶天中，儀圖所准。

translations.literal: Their numbers are constantly fixed, girdling the center of heaven—the standard of armillary diagrams.
translations.idiomatic: Their numbers are constantly fixed, girdling the center of heaven—the standard of armillary diagrams.

sentences.zh: 日月往來，隨交損益。

translations.literal: Sun and Moon come and go, gaining and losing with the crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and Moon come and go, gaining and losing with the crossing.

sentences.zh: 所入宿度，進退不同。

translations.literal: The lodge degrees entered differ in advance and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: The lodge degrees entered differ in advance and retreat.

sentences.zh: 黃道宿度左中郎將賈達檢日月所去赤道不同，更鑄黃道渾儀所檢者。

translations.literal: The ecliptic lodge degrees—Left Palace Attendant Jia Da checked that the Sun and Moon's departure from the equator differs—were checked with a newly cast ecliptic armillary sphere.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic lodge degrees—Left Palace Attendant Jia Da checked that the Sun and Moon's departure from the equator differs—were verified with a newly cast ecliptic armillary sphere.

sentences.zh: 臣等今所修撰討論，更造木渾圖交絡調賦黃赤二道三百六十五度有奇，校量大率，與此符會。

translations.literal: We who compile and discuss here have newly made a wooden armillary diagram interlacing and balancing the yellow and red two paths at three hundred sixty-five odd degrees; measured at large rate, it agrees with this.
translations.idiomatic: We who compile and discuss here have newly made a wooden armillary diagram interlacing and balancing the yellow and red two paths at three hundred sixty-five odd degrees; measured at large rate, it agrees with this.

sentences.zh: 今曆以步日行月及五星出入循此。

translations.literal: The present calendar derives solar daily motion, lunar motion, and the ingress and egress of the five stars according to this.
translations.idiomatic: The present calendar derives solar daily motion, lunar motion, and the ingress and egress of the five stars according to this.

sentences.zh: 其月行交絡黃道，進退亦宜有別。

translations.literal: The Moon's motion crossing and interlacing the ecliptic should also differ in advance and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon's motion crossing and interlacing the ecliptic should also differ in advance and retreat.

sentences.zh: 每交輒差，不可詳盡。

translations.literal: At each crossing there is always difference—it cannot be detailed exhaustively.
translations.idiomatic: At each crossing there is always difference—it cannot be detailed exhaustively.

sentences.zh: 今亦依黃道推步。

translations.literal: Now we also derive according to the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Now we also derive according to the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 推日躔術

translations.literal: Procedure for deriving solar lodges
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for deriving solar lodges

sentences.zh: 置冬至初日躔差率，加總法，乘冬至小餘，如總法而一，以減天宿度分。

translations.literal: Set the winter-solstice first-day lodge-difference rate; add common divisor; multiply by winter-solstice small remainder; divide by common divisor; subtract from celestial lodge degree and fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Set the winter-solstice first-day lodge-difference rate; add the common divisor; multiply by the winter-solstice small remainder; divide by the common divisor; subtract from the celestial lodge degree and fraction.

sentences.zh: 其餘命起黃道鬥十二度，宿次去之，經鬥去宿分度，不滿宿算外，即所求年冬至夜半所在宿度算及分。

translations.literal: With the remainder, assign beginning from Yellow Way Dipper twelve degrees; remove by lodge sequence; pass Dipper and remove lodge fraction and degree; outside the count when insufficient to fill a lodge—that is the lodge degree count and fraction where the winter solstice midnight of the year sought lies.
translations.idiomatic: With the remainder, assign beginning from Yellow Way Dipper twelve degrees; remove by lodge sequence; pass Dipper and remove lodge fraction and degree; outside the count when insufficient to fill a lodge—that is the lodge degree count and fraction where the winter solstice midnight of the year sought lies.

sentences.zh: 求每定氣初日夜半日所在定度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the fixed degree where the Sun lies at midnight on the first day of each fixed qi
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed degree where the Sun lies at midnight on the first day of each fixed qi

sentences.zh: 各以其定氣初日躔差率，乘氣定餘，總法而一，進加退減餘為分，以減定氣日度及分，命以宿次如前，即其夜半度及春秋二分定氣初日為進退之始，當平行一度。

translations.literal: Each takes that fixed qi's first-day lodge-difference rate, multiplies by the qi's fixed remainder, divides by common divisor; advance-add and retreat-subtract remainder as parts; subtract from the fixed qi's solar degree and fraction; assign by lodge sequence as before—that is its midnight degree, and the fixed qi's first days of spring and autumn equinoxes are the start of advance and retreat, corresponding to one degree of uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: Each takes that fixed qi's first-day lodge-difference rate, multiplies by the qi's fixed remainder, and divides by the common divisor; advance-add and retreat-subtract the remainder as parts; subtract from the fixed qi's solar degree and fraction; assign by lodge sequence as before—that is its midnight degree, and the fixed qi's first days of spring and autumn equinoxes are the start of advance and retreat, corresponding to one degree of uniform motion.

sentences.zh: 自餘依進加退減度之。

translations.literal: For the rest, add degrees by advance and subtract by retreat.
translations.idiomatic: For the rest, add degrees by advance and subtract by retreat.

sentences.zh: 求次日夜半日所在定度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the fixed degree where the Sun lies at midnight on the next day
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed degree where the Sun lies at midnight on the next day

sentences.zh: 各因定氣夜半所在為本，加度一。

translations.literal: Each takes the fixed-qi midnight position as base and adds one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Each takes the fixed-qi midnight position as base and adds one degree.

sentences.zh: 又以其日躔差率，進加退減度分。

translations.literal: Also with that day's lodge-difference rate, advance-add and retreat-subtract degree and fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Also with that day's lodge-difference rate, advance-add and retreat-subtract degree and fraction.

sentences.zh: 滿若不足，並依前例。

translations.literal: When full or insufficient, all follow the preceding pattern.
translations.idiomatic: When full or insufficient, all follow the preceding pattern.

sentences.zh: 去命如上，即得所求。

translations.literal: Remove and assign as above—then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Remove and assign as above—then obtain what is sought.

sentences.zh: 其定朔弦望夜半日度，各隨定氣，以其日月名亦直而分別之。

translations.literal: The midnight solar degrees for fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon each follow fixed qi; assign their day and month names directly and distinguish them.
translations.idiomatic: The midnight solar degrees for fixed new moon, quarters, and full moon each follow fixed qi; assign their day and month names directly and distinguish them.

sentences.zh: 勘右依恆有餘，從定恆行度，不用躔差。

translations.literal: Examined at right: following the mean there is remainder; proceed from fixed-mean motion in degrees—do not use lodge difference.
translations.idiomatic: Examined at right: following the mean there is remainder; proceed from fixed-mean motion in degrees—do not use lodge difference.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望定日夜辰所加日度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the solar degrees added at the fixed day and double-hour of new moon, quarters, and full moon
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the solar degrees added at the fixed day and double-hour of new moon, quarters, and full moon

sentences.zh: 各以其定小餘為平分。

translations.literal: Each takes its fixed small remainder as equal fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Each takes its fixed small remainder as the equal fraction.

sentences.zh: 又定小餘乘其日所躔差率，總法而一，乃進加退減其平分，以加其夜半日度，即各定辰所加。

translations.literal: Also multiply fixed small remainder by that day's lodge-difference rate, divide by common divisor; then advance-add and retreat-subtract its equal fraction; add to its midnight solar degree—that is what each fixed double-hour adds.
translations.idiomatic: Also multiply the fixed small remainder by that day's lodge-difference rate and divide by the common divisor; then advance-add and retreat-subtract its equal fraction; add to its midnight solar degree—that is what each fixed double-hour adds.

sentences.zh: 其與五星加減者，半其分，消息月朔者，應推月度所須，皆依本朔大小。

translations.literal: Where it adds and subtracts with the five stars, halve the fraction; where the monthly new moon is adjusted, what lunar motion requires—all follow the original new moon's long or short month.
translations.idiomatic: Where it adds and subtracts with the five stars, halve the fraction; where the monthly new moon is adjusted, what lunar motion requires—all follow the original new moon's long or short month.

sentences.zh: 若注曆，依甲子乙丑各擬入。

translations.literal: If annotating the calendar, assign entry according to jiazi and yichou respectively.
translations.idiomatic: If annotating the calendar, assign entry according to jiazi and yichou respectively.

sentences.zh: 推月離術

translations.literal: Procedure for deriving lunar separation
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for deriving lunar separation

sentences.zh: 求朔望定日辰月所在度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the degree where the Moon lies at the fixed day and double-hour of new and full moon
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the degree where the Moon lies at the fixed day and double-hour of new and full moon

sentences.zh: 各置朔弦望定辰所加日度及分。

translations.literal: Set the solar degree and fraction added at the fixed double-hour of each new moon, quarter, and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar degree and fraction added at the fixed double-hour of each new moon, quarter, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 凡朔定辰所加為合朔，日月同度。

translations.literal: In general what the fixed new-moon double-hour adds is conjunction new moon—Sun and Moon at the same degree.
translations.idiomatic: In general what the fixed new-moon double-hour adds is conjunction new moon—Sun and Moon at the same degree.

sentences.zh: 上弦加度九十一、分四百一十七。

translations.literal: First quarter: add ninety-one degrees, four hundred seventeen parts.
translations.idiomatic: First quarter: add ninety-one degrees, four hundred seventeen parts.

sentences.zh: 望加度一百八十三、分八百三十四。

translations.literal: Full moon: add one hundred eighty-three degrees, eight hundred thirty-four parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full moon: add one hundred eighty-three degrees, eight hundred thirty-four parts.

sentences.zh: 下弦加度二百七十三、分一千二百五十一。

translations.literal: Last quarter: add two hundred seventy-three degrees, one thousand two hundred fifty-one parts.
translations.idiomatic: Last quarter: add two hundred seventy-three degrees, one thousand two hundred fifty-one parts.

sentences.zh: 訖，各半而十退之，為程度分。

translations.literal: When complete, halve each and retreat by ten—the result is cycle degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: When complete, halve each and retreat by ten—the result is cycle degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 求次月定朔夜半入變曆術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding entry into the change cycle at midnight of the next month's fixed new moon
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding entry into the change cycle at midnight of the next month's fixed new moon

sentences.zh: 置天正恆朔夜半所入變日及餘。

translations.literal: Set the change day and remainder entered at midnight of the celestial first month's mean new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Set the change day and remainder entered at midnight of the celestial first month's mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 定朔有進退一日者，進退一日，為定朔夜半所入。

translations.literal: If the fixed new moon advances or retreats one day, advance or retreat one day for what is entered at fixed-new-moon midnight.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new moon advances or retreats one day, advance or retreat one day for what is entered at fixed-new-moon midnight.

sentences.zh: 月大加二日，月小加一日。

translations.literal: Long month adds two days; short month adds one day.
translations.idiomatic: Long month adds two days; short month adds one day.

sentences.zh: 餘皆五百九十六、奇十六。

translations.literal: Remainders are all five hundred ninety-six, with fraction sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: Remainders are all five hundred ninety-six, with fraction sixteen.

sentences.zh: 求次日夜半所入變曆術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding entry into the change cycle at the next day's midnight
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding entry into the change cycle at the next day's midnight

sentences.zh: 因定朔夜半所入日算，加日一，滿皆如前。

translations.literal: From the day count entered at fixed-new-moon midnight, add one day; when full, all as before.
translations.idiomatic: From the day count entered at fixed-new-moon midnight, add one day; when full, all as before.

sentences.zh: 其弦皆依前定日所在求之。

translations.literal: The quarters are all sought according to where the preceding fixed day lies.
translations.idiomatic: The quarters are all sought according to where the preceding fixed day lies.

sentences.zh: 求變日定離程術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the fixed separation course for change days
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed separation course for change days

sentences.zh: 各以其日夜半入變餘，乘離差，總法而一，為見差。

translations.literal: Each multiplies that day's midnight entered change remainder by separation difference, divides by common divisor—that is visible difference.
translations.idiomatic: Each multiplies that day's midnight entered change remainder by separation difference and divides by the common divisor—that is the visible difference.

sentences.zh: 以進加退減其日離程，為月每日所離定程。

translations.literal: Advance-add and retreat-subtract to its daily separation course—that is the Moon's fixed daily separation course.
translations.idiomatic: Advance-add and retreat-subtract to its daily separation course—that is the Moon's fixed daily separation course.
