sentences.zh: 求朔弦望之定日夜半月所在度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the degree where the Moon lies at midnight on the fixed day of new moon, quarters, and full moon
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the degree where the Moon lies at midnight on the fixed day of new moon, quarters, and full moon

sentences.zh: 各以其日定小餘，乘所入變日離定程，總法而一，為夜半後分。

translations.literal: Each multiplies that day's fixed small remainder by the entered change day's fixed separation course, divides by common divisor—that is the fraction after midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Each multiplies that day's fixed small remainder by the entered change day's fixed separation course and divides by the common divisor—that is the fraction after midnight.

sentences.zh: 滿程法為度，餘為度分。

translations.literal: When it fills the course divisor it becomes degrees; remainder is degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the course divisor it becomes degrees; the remainder is degree-parts.

sentences.zh: 以減其日加辰所在度及分，命以黃道宿度，即其所求。

translations.literal: Subtract from the degree and fraction where that day's added double-hour lies; assign by ecliptic lodge degrees—that is what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the degree and fraction where that day's added double-hour lies; assign by ecliptic lodge degrees—that is what is sought.

sentences.zh: 次日夜半，各以離定程加朔弦望夜半所在分，滿程法從度，去命以黃道宿度算外，則次日夜半月度。

translations.literal: At the next day's midnight, add the fixed separation course to the fraction where new moon, quarters, and full moon lie at midnight; when it fills the course divisor carry to degrees; remove and assign by ecliptic lodge degree count outside—that is the Moon's degree at the next midnight.
translations.idiomatic: At the next day's midnight, add the fixed separation course to the fraction where new moon, quarters, and full moon lie at midnight; when it fills the course divisor carry to degrees; remove and assign by ecliptic lodge degree count outside—that is the Moon's degree at the next midnight.

sentences.zh: 求晨昏度，以其日離定程乘其日夜刻，二百而一，為昏分，滿程法為度。

translations.literal: To find dawn and dusk degrees, multiply that day's fixed separation course by that day's day-and-night clepsydra marks; divide by two hundred—that is dusk fraction; when it fills the course divisor it becomes degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find dawn and dusk degrees, multiply that day's fixed separation course by that day's day-and-night clepsydra marks and divide by two hundred—that is the dusk fraction; when it fills the course divisor it becomes degrees.

sentences.zh: 望前以昏，後以晨，加夜半度，得所求。

translations.literal: Before full moon use dusk; after use dawn; add to midnight degrees—to obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Before full moon use dusk; after use dawn; add to midnight degrees—to obtain what is sought.

sentences.zh: 其弦望以五乘定小餘，程法一，為刻，即各其辰所入刻數。

translations.literal: For quarters and full moon, multiply fixed small remainder by five; divide by course divisor one—that is clepsydra marks; that is the clepsydra-mark number entered for each double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: For quarters and full moon, multiply the fixed small remainder by five and divide by course divisor one—that is clepsydra marks; that is the clepsydra-mark number entered for each double-hour.

sentences.zh: 皆減其晨前刻，不盡為晨後刻。

translations.literal: All subtract the marks before dawn; what remains is the marks after dawn.
translations.idiomatic: All subtract the marks before dawn; what remains is the marks after dawn.

sentences.zh: 不滿晨前刻者，從前日注曆，伺候推。

translations.literal: If insufficient for marks before dawn, follow the previous day's calendar annotation and wait to derive.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient for marks before dawn, follow the previous day's calendar annotation and wait to derive.

sentences.zh: 總刻：一百。

translations.literal: Total marks: one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Total marks: one hundred.

sentences.zh: 辰刻：分十一。

translations.literal: Double-hour marks: divide eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Double-hour marks: divide eleven.

sentences.zh: 刻分法：七十二。

translations.literal: Clepsydra-mark fraction divisor: seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: Clepsydra-mark fraction divisor: seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 求定氣日晝夜漏刻及日出沒術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding day-and-night clepsydra marks of fixed-qi days and sunrise and sunset
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding day-and-night clepsydra marks of fixed-qi days and sunrise and sunset

sentences.zh: 倍其氣晨前刻及分，滿法從刻，為日不見漏。

translations.literal: Double its qi's marks before dawn and fraction; when full carry from marks—that is the clepsydra of invisible sun.
translations.idiomatic: Double its qi's marks before dawn and fraction; when full carry from marks—that is the clepsydra of invisible sun.

sentences.zh: 以減百刻，餘為日見漏。

translations.literal: Subtract from one hundred marks; remainder is clepsydra of visible sun.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from one hundred marks; the remainder is the clepsydra of visible sun.

sentences.zh: 五刻晝漏刻。

translations.literal: Five marks: day clepsydra marks.
translations.idiomatic: Day clepsydra marks: five marks.

sentences.zh: 以晝漏刻減百刻，餘夜漏刻。

translations.literal: Subtract day clepsydra marks from one hundred marks; remainder is night clepsydra marks.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract day clepsydra marks from one hundred marks; the remainder is night clepsydra marks.

sentences.zh: 以四刻十二分加晨前漏刻，命起子初刻算外，即日出辰刻。

translations.literal: Add four marks twelve parts to clepsydra marks before dawn; assign beginning from zi initial mark beyond the count—that is the double-hour mark of sunrise.
translations.idiomatic: Add four marks twelve parts to clepsydra marks before dawn; assign beginning from zi initial mark beyond the count—that is the double-hour mark of sunrise.

sentences.zh: 以日見漏加日出刻辰，以次如前，即日沒所在辰刻。

translations.literal: Add visible-sun clepsydra to sunrise mark and double-hour; in order as before—that is the double-hour mark where the sun sets.
translations.idiomatic: Add visible-sun clepsydra to sunrise mark and double-hour; in order as before—that is the double-hour mark where the sun sets.

sentences.zh: 以二十五除從夜漏，得每更一籌之數。

translations.literal: Divide night clepsydra by twenty-five to obtain the count for each watch tally.
translations.idiomatic: Divide night clepsydra by twenty-five to obtain the count for each watch tally.

sentences.zh: 以二刻三十六分加日沒辰刻，即甲辰刻，又以更籌數加之，得甲夜一籌數。

translations.literal: Add two marks thirty-six parts to sunset double-hour mark—that is first-yin mark; also add watch-tally count to obtain the first watch tally of the night.
translations.idiomatic: Add two marks thirty-six parts to sunset double-hour mark—that is first-yin mark; also add watch-tally count to obtain the first watch tally of the night.

sentences.zh: 以次累加，滿辰去命之，即五更夜籌所以當辰刻及也，以配二十一箭漏之法也。

translations.literal: Accumulate in order; when full remove by double-hour and assign—that is how the five watches' night tallies correspond to double-hour marks, matching the method of twenty-one-arrow clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate in order; when full remove by double-hour and assign—that is how the five watches' night tallies correspond to double-hour marks, matching the method of twenty-one-arrow clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 求每日並屈申數術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding daily combined flexion and extension numbers
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding daily combined flexion and extension numbers

sentences.zh: 每氣准為一十五日，各置其氣屈申率。

translations.literal: Each qi is taken as fifteen days; set each qi's flexion-extension rate.
translations.idiomatic: Each qi is taken as fifteen days; set each qi's flexion-extension rate.

sentences.zh: 每以發斂差損益之，差滿十從分，分滿十從率一，即各每日屈申率。

translations.literal: Each uses waxing-waning difference to gain and lose; when difference fills ten carry to parts, when parts fill ten carry one to rate—that is each day's flexion-extension rate.
translations.idiomatic: Each uses waxing-waning difference to gain and lose; when difference fills ten carry to parts, when parts fill ten carry one to rate—that is each day's flexion-extension rate.

sentences.zh: 各累計屈申率為刻分，乃以一百八十乘刻分，泛差十一乘綱紀而除之，得為刻差，滿法為刻。

translations.literal: Accumulate flexion-extension rates as clepsydra parts; then multiply clepsydra parts by one hundred eighty; multiply general difference by guideline and cycle and divide—to obtain clepsydra difference; when full of divisor it becomes marks.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate flexion-extension rates as clepsydra parts; then multiply clepsydra parts by one hundred eighty; multiply general difference by guideline and cycle and divide—to obtain clepsydra difference; when full of divisor it becomes marks.

sentences.zh: 隨氣所在，以申減屈加不見漏而半之，為晨前定刻。

translations.literal: Following where the qi lies, subtract extension and add flexion to invisible clepsydra and halve—that is the fixed marks before dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Following where the qi lies, subtract extension and add flexion to invisible clepsydra and halve—that is the fixed marks before dawn.

sentences.zh: 每求次日，各如前法。

translations.literal: Each time the next day is sought, all as the preceding method.
translations.idiomatic: Each time the next day is sought, all as the preceding method.

sentences.zh: 時加其如始，隨加辰日晚，以率課之。

translations.literal: Add time as at the beginning; as added double-hours make the day late, assess by rate.
translations.idiomatic: Add time as at the beginning; as added double-hours make the day late, assess by rate.

sentences.zh: 求黃道去極每日差術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the daily difference of the ecliptic's departure from the pole
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the daily difference of the ecliptic's departure from the pole

sentences.zh: 置刻差，三十而一為度。

translations.literal: Set clepsydra difference; divide by thirty for degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Set the clepsydra difference; divide by thirty to obtain degrees.

sentences.zh: 不滿三約為分。

translations.literal: What does not fill thirty, reduce for parts.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill thirty counts as fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 申減屈加其氣初黃道度，即每日所求。

translations.literal: Subtract extension and add flexion to its qi initial ecliptic degree—that is what is sought for each day.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract extension and add flexion to that qi's initial ecliptic degree—that gives what is sought for each day.

sentences.zh: 求昏旦去中星度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding dusk and dawn departure from culmination-star degrees
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding dusk and dawn departure from culmination-star degrees

sentences.zh: 每日求其晝漏刻數，以乘期實，二百乘總法而除之，得昏去中星度。

translations.literal: Each day find its day clepsydra mark count; multiply by period constant; divide by two hundred times common divisor—to obtain dusk departure from culmination-star degree.
translations.idiomatic: Each day find its day clepsydra mark count; multiply by the period constant; divide by two hundred times the common divisor—to obtain the dusk departure from culmination-star degree.

sentences.zh: 以減周天度，餘為晨去中星度。

translations.literal: Subtract from circuit-of-heaven degrees; remainder is dawn departure from culmination-star degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the circuit-of-heaven degrees; the remainder is the dawn departure from culmination-star degree.

sentences.zh: 以昏旦去中星度，加其辰日所在，即各其日中宿度。

translations.literal: Add dusk and dawn departure from culmination-star degrees to where the double-hour day lies—that is each noon lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the dusk and dawn departure from culmination-star degrees to where the double-hour day lies—that gives each noon lodge degree.

sentences.zh: 其梗概粗舉者，加其夜半日度，各其日中星宿度。

translations.literal: For the rough outline method, add midnight solar degree—each noon star lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: For the rough outline method, add the midnight solar degree to obtain each noon star lodge degree.

sentences.zh: 因求次日者，各置其四刻差，七十二乘之，二百八十八而一度。

translations.literal: For seeking the next day, set each its four-mark difference; multiply by seventy-two; two hundred eighty-eight per degree.
translations.idiomatic: To seek the next day, set each day's four-mark difference; multiply by seventy-two; two hundred eighty-eight make one degree.

sentences.zh: 冬至後加，夏至後減。

translations.literal: After winter solstice add; after summer solstice subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice add; after the summer solstice subtract.

sentences.zh: 隨日加，各得每日去中度。

translations.literal: Add day by day; each obtains daily departure from center degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add day by day; each step yields the daily departure from center degree.

sentences.zh: 晨昏所距日在黃道中星准度，以赤道計之。

translations.literal: Dawn and dusk distance from the Sun at the ecliptic median-star standard degree, calculated by the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The dawn and dusk distance from the Sun at the ecliptic median-star standard degree is calculated by the equator.

sentences.zh: 其赤道同太初星距。

translations.literal: Its equator matches Taichu star distances.
translations.idiomatic: Its equatorial distances match those of the Taichu calendar.

sentences.zh: 推遊交術

translations.literal: Procedure for calculating wandering-node crossing
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for calculating wandering-node crossing

sentences.zh: 終率：一千九十三萬九千三百一十三。

translations.literal: Terminal rate: ten million nine hundred thirty-nine thousand three hundred thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal rate: 10,939,313.

sentences.zh: 奇率：三百。

translations.literal: Odd rate: three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Odd rate: 300.

sentences.zh: 約終：三萬六千四百六十四奇一百一十三。

translations.literal: Reduced terminal: thirty-six thousand four hundred sixty-four odd one hundred thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: Reduced terminal: 36,464 odd 113.

sentences.zh: 交中：一萬八千二百三十二奇五十六半。

translations.literal: Crossing center: eighteen thousand two hundred thirty-two odd fifty-six and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing center: 18,232 odd 56½.

sentences.zh: 交中日：二十七餘二百八十四奇一百一十三。

translations.literal: Crossing middle days: twenty-seven remainder two hundred eighty-four odd one hundred thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing middle days: 27 remainder 284 odd 113.

sentences.zh: 中日：十三餘八百一十二奇五十六半。

translations.literal: Middle day: thirteen remainder eight hundred twelve odd fifty-six and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Middle day: 13 remainder 812 odd 56½.

sentences.zh: 虧朔：三千一百六奇一百八十七。

translations.literal: Waning new moon: three hundred sixteen odd one hundred eighty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Waning new moon: 316 odd 187.

sentences.zh: 實望：一萬九千七百八十五奇一百五十。

translations.literal: True full moon: nineteen thousand seven hundred eighty-five odd one hundred fifty.
translations.idiomatic: True full moon: 19,785 odd 150.

sentences.zh: 後准：一百五十二奇九百三半。

translations.literal: Rear criterion: one hundred fifty-two odd nine hundred three and a half.
translations.idiomatic: Rear criterion: 152 odd 903½.

sentences.zh: 前准：一萬六千六百七十八奇二百六十三。

translations.literal: Front criterion: sixteen thousand six hundred seventy-eight odd two hundred sixty-three.
translations.idiomatic: Front criterion: 16,678 odd 263.

sentences.zh: 求月行入交表裏術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the Moon's motion entry into crossing outside and inside
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the Moon's entry into crossing outside and inside

sentences.zh: 置總實，以終率去之。

translations.literal: Set total constant; remove by terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the total constant; remove by the terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 不足去者，奇率乘之。

translations.literal: What does not suffice to remove, multiply by odd rate.
translations.idiomatic: What does not suffice to remove, multiply by the odd rate.

sentences.zh: 滿終率，又去之。

translations.literal: When full of terminal rate, remove again.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the terminal rate, remove again.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，奇率約之，為天正恆朔夜半入交分。

translations.literal: What does not fill, reduce by odd rate—that is celestial first-month mean new moon midnight crossing-entry fraction.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill, reduce by the odd rate—that is the crossing-entry fraction at midnight of the celestial first-month mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 不盡，為奇。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is odd.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted is the odd fraction.

sentences.zh: 以總法約入交分，為日。

translations.literal: Reduce crossing-entry fraction by common divisor—that is days.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the crossing-entry fraction by the common divisor—that gives days.

sentences.zh: 不盡，為餘。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is remainder.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted is the remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，即天正恆朔夜半入交日算及餘、奇。

translations.literal: Count days outside the calculation—that is celestial first-month mean new moon midnight crossing-entry day count and remainder and odd.
translations.idiomatic: Count days outside the reckoning—that gives the crossing-entry day count, remainder, and odd at midnight of the celestial first-month mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 天正定朔有進退日者，依所進退一日，為朔所入。

translations.literal: When the celestial first-month fixed new moon has advance or retreat of a day, follow the advance or retreat one day for what conjunction enters.
translations.idiomatic: When the celestial first-month fixed new moon advances or retreats one day, advance or retreat one day for what the conjunction enters.

sentences.zh: 日不滿中日及餘、奇者，為月在外；

translations.literal: When day does not fill middle day and remainder and odd, Moon is outside;
translations.idiomatic: When the day does not fill the middle day and remainder and odd, the Moon is outside;

sentences.zh: 滿，去之，餘皆一為月在內。

translations.literal: When full, remove; all remainder is one—Moon is inside.
translations.idiomatic: When full, remove; when the remainder is all one, the Moon is inside.

sentences.zh: 大月加二日，小月加一日，餘皆一千五十五、奇一百八十七。

translations.literal: Long month add two days; short month add one day; remainders all one thousand fifty-five odd one hundred eighty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Long month add two days; short month add one day; remainders are all 1,055 odd 187.

sentences.zh: 求次日，加一日，滿中日者，皆去之，餘為入次。

translations.literal: Seek next day; add one day; when full of middle day all remove; remainder is next entry.
translations.idiomatic: To seek the next day, add one day; when full of the middle day remove all; the remainder is the next entry.

sentences.zh: 一表一里，迭互入之。

translations.literal: One outside one inside, alternately enter.
translations.idiomatic: One outside and one inside, entering alternately.

sentences.zh: 求月入交去日道遠近術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the Moon's entry into crossing distance from the solar path near and far
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the Moon's entry into crossing and its distance from the solar path

sentences.zh: 置所入日差，並後差半之，為通率。

translations.literal: Set entered day difference; combine with rear difference and halve—that is common rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entered day difference; combine with the rear difference and halve—that is the common rate.

sentences.zh: 進，以入日餘減總法，以乘差，總法而一，並差以半之。

translations.literal: For advance: subtract entered day remainder from common divisor; multiply difference; divide by common divisor; combine with difference and halve.
translations.idiomatic: For advance: subtract the entered day remainder from the common divisor; multiply by the difference and divide by the common divisor; combine with the difference and halve.

sentences.zh: 退者，半入餘，以乘差，總法而一。

translations.literal: For retreat: halve entered remainder; multiply difference; divide by common divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For retreat: halve the entered remainder; multiply by the difference and divide by the common divisor.

sentences.zh: 皆加通率，為交定率。

translations.literal: All add to common rate—that is crossing fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: In all cases add to the common rate—that is the crossing fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 乃以入餘乘定總法。

translations.literal: Then multiply entered remainder by fixed total divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Then multiply the entered remainder by the fixed total divisor.

sentences.zh: 乃進退差積，滿十為度，不滿為分，即各其日月去日道度數。

translations.literal: Then advance-and-retreat difference accumulation; when full of ten is degrees, not full is parts—that is each Sun and Moon departure from solar path degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Then apply the advance-and-retreat difference accumulation; when full of ten counts as degrees, what does not fill counts as parts—that gives each day's Sun and Moon departure from the solar path in degrees.

sentences.zh: 每求日道宿度去極數，其入七日，餘一千七十六、奇二十八少已下者，進，已上，盡全；

translations.literal: Each time seeking solar-path lodge degree departure-from-pole number: on entered day seven, when remainder one thousand seventy-six odd twenty-eight minor or below, advance; when above, take entirely;
translations.idiomatic: Each time the solar-path lodge degree departure-from-pole number is sought: on entered day seven, when the remainder is 1,076 odd 28 minor or below, advance; when above, take entirely;

sentences.zh: 餘二百六十三、奇二百七十一大者，退入十四日，如交餘奇已下者，退；

translations.literal: When remainder two hundred sixty-three odd two hundred seventy-one major or greater, retreat and enter day fourteen; when like crossing remainder odd or below, retreat;
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder is 263 odd 271 major or greater, retreat and enter day fourteen; when like the crossing remainder odd or below, retreat;

sentences.zh: 其入已上，盡全；

translations.literal: When entered is above, take entirely;
translations.idiomatic: When the entered value is above, take entirely;

sentences.zh: 餘五百二十七、奇二百四十二半者，進。

translations.literal: When remainder five hundred twenty-seven odd two hundred forty-two and a half, advance.
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder is 527 odd 242½, advance.

sentences.zh: 而終其要為五分。

translations.literal: And in the end the essential is five parts.
translations.idiomatic: In the end the essential value is five parts.

sentences.zh: 初則七日四分，十四日三分；

translations.literal: Initially then seven days four parts, fourteen days three parts;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, seven days yield four parts and fourteen days yield three parts;

sentences.zh: 末則七日後一分，十四日後二分。

translations.literal: Finally then after seven days one part, after fourteen days two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Finally, after seven days one part and after fourteen days two parts.

sentences.zh: 雖初強末弱，差率有檢，月道一度半強已下者，為沾黃道。

translations.literal: Though initially strong and finally weak, difference rate has check; when lunar path is one degree and a half strong or below, it is touching the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Though initially strong and finally weak, the difference rate has a check; when the lunar path is one and a half degrees strong or below, it is touching the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 當朔望，則有虧。

translations.literal: At new and full moon, then there is waning.
translations.idiomatic: At new and full moon, there is then eclipse waning.

sentences.zh: 遇五星在黃道者，則相侵掩。

translations.literal: When encountering five planets on the ecliptic, then mutual invasion and occultation.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets lie on the ecliptic, mutual invasion and occultation then occur.

sentences.zh: 求所在宿術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding lodge entered
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the lodge entered

sentences.zh: 求夜半入交日十三算者及餘，以減中日及餘，不盡者，以乘其日離定程，總法而一，為離分，滿程為度，以加其日夜半月所在宿度算及分，求次交准此，各得其定交所在度。

translations.literal: Find midnight crossing-entry day thirteen count and remainder; subtract from middle day and remainder; what is not exhausted, multiply by that day's fixed separation course, divide by common divisor—that is separation fraction; when full of course is degree; add to that day-and-night half-Moon lodge degree count and fraction; seek next crossing likewise—each obtains fixed crossing lodge degree entered.
translations.idiomatic: Find the midnight crossing-entry day count of thirteen and its remainder; subtract from the middle day and remainder; multiply what is not exhausted by that day's fixed separation course and divide by the common divisor—that is the separation fraction; when full of the course counts as a degree; add to that day-and-night half-Moon lodge degree count and fraction; seek the next crossing likewise—each yields the fixed crossing lodge degree entered.

sentences.zh: 置前後定交所宿度算及分，半之，即各表裏極所在宿度及分。

translations.literal: Set front and rear fixed crossing lodge degree count and fraction; halve—that is each outside-and-inside pole lodge degree and fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Set the front and rear fixed crossing lodge degree count and fraction; halve—that gives each outside-and-inside pole lodge degree and fraction.

sentences.zh: 求恆朔望泛交分野

translations.literal: Finding mean new and full moon general crossing fraction field
translations.idiomatic: Finding the general crossing fraction field for mean new and full moon

sentences.zh: 因天正恆朔夜半入交分，以天正恆朔泛交分求望泛交，以實望加之。

translations.literal: From celestial first-month mean new moon midnight crossing-entry fraction, use celestial first-month mean new moon general crossing fraction to find full-moon general crossing; add true full moon.
translations.idiomatic: From the crossing-entry fraction at midnight of the celestial first-month mean new moon, use the celestial first-month mean new moon general crossing fraction to find the full-moon general crossing; add the true full moon.

sentences.zh: 又加，得次月恆朔泛交分。

translations.literal: Add again to obtain next month mean new moon general crossing fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Add again to obtain the next month's mean new moon general crossing fraction.

sentences.zh: 滿約終及奇，去之。

translations.literal: When full of reduced terminal and odd, remove.
translations.idiomatic: When full of the reduced terminal and odd, remove.

sentences.zh: 次求次朔，以虧望加之。

translations.literal: Next seek next new moon; add waning full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Next seek the following new moon; add the waning full moon.

sentences.zh: 求朔望入常交分術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding new and full moon entry into regular crossing fraction
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding new and full moon entry into regular crossing fraction

sentences.zh: 以入氣盈朒定積，盈加朒減其恆泛交分，滿若不足，進退約終。

translations.literal: Use entered-qi excess-deficiency fixed accumulation; excess add and deficiency subtract from mean general crossing fraction; when full or insufficient, advance and retreat reduced terminal.
translations.idiomatic: Use the entered-qi excess-deficiency fixed accumulation; excess adds and deficiency subtracts from the mean general crossing fraction; when full or insufficient, advance and retreat the reduced terminal.

sentences.zh: 即其常分交。

translations.literal: That is its regular crossing fraction.
translations.idiomatic: That is its regular crossing fraction.

sentences.zh: 求朔望定交分術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding fixed crossing fraction at new and full moon
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the fixed crossing fraction at new and full moon

sentences.zh: 以六十乘定遲速，以七百七十七降除之，所得為限數。

translations.literal: Multiply fixed slow-fast by sixty; reduce and divide by seven hundred seventy-seven—the result is limit number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed slow-fast by sixty; reduce and divide by 777—the result is the limit number.

sentences.zh: 速減遲加如常。

translations.literal: Fast subtracts and slow adds as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Fast subtracts and slow adds as usual.

sentences.zh: 其數朔入交月在日道里者，以所入限數減定遲速，餘以速減遲加其定交分。

translations.literal: When at new moon the Moon entering crossing is inside the solar path, subtract limit number entered from fixed slow-fast; remainder—fast subtracts and slow adds to its fixed crossing fraction.
translations.idiomatic: When at new moon the Moon entering the crossing is inside the solar path, subtract the limit number entered from the fixed slow-fast; with the remainder, fast subtracts and slow adds to its fixed crossing fraction.

sentences.zh: 而出日道表者，為變交分。

translations.literal: When exiting outside the solar path, that is changed crossing fraction.
translations.idiomatic: When it exits outside the solar path, that is the changed crossing fraction.

sentences.zh: 加減不出日道表，即依定交分求蝕分。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction do not exit outside the solar path, then follow fixed crossing fraction to find eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: When addition and subtraction do not exit outside the solar path, follow the fixed crossing fraction to find the eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 其變交分出日道表三時半內者，檢其前後月望入交分數多少，依月虧初復末定蝕術，注消息，以定蝕不。

translations.literal: When changed crossing fraction exits outside the solar path within three and a half double-hours, check preceding and following month full-moon crossing-entry fraction amounts; follow lunar waning initial, restoration, and final fixed eclipse procedure; note waxing and waning—to fix whether there is eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When the changed crossing fraction exits outside the solar path within three and a half double-hours, check the preceding and following month's full-moon crossing-entry fraction amounts; follow the lunar waning initial, restoration, and final fixed eclipse procedure; note waxing and waning—to determine whether there is an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求入蝕限術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding entry into eclipse limit
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding entry into eclipse limit

sentences.zh: 其入交定分，如交中已下者，為月在外道；

translations.literal: When crossing-entry fixed fraction is at crossing center or below, Moon is on outer path;
translations.idiomatic: When the crossing-entry fixed fraction is at the crossing center or below, the Moon is on the outer path;

sentences.zh: 交中已上者，以交中減之，餘為月在內。

translations.literal: When above crossing center, subtract crossing center; remainder is Moon inside.
translations.idiomatic: When above the crossing center, subtract the crossing center; the remainder is the Moon inside.

sentences.zh: 其分如後准已下、前准已上者，為入蝕限。

translations.literal: When fraction is at rear criterion or below and front criterion or above, that is entry into eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: When the fraction is at the rear criterion or below and the front criterion or above, that is entry into the eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 望則月蝕，朔入限，月在裏者，日蝕。

translations.literal: At full moon then lunar eclipse; at new moon entering limit, Moon inside means solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon there is lunar eclipse; at new moon entering the limit, when the Moon is inside there is solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 入限如後准已下者，為交後分；

translations.literal: When entering limit is at rear criterion or below, that is post-crossing fraction;
translations.idiomatic: When the entry into the limit is at the rear criterion or below, that is the post-crossing fraction;

sentences.zh: 前准已上者，反減交中，餘為交前分。

translations.literal: When at front criterion or above, inversely subtract crossing center; remainder is pre-crossing fraction.
translations.idiomatic: When at the front criterion or above, subtract inversely from the crossing center; the remainder is the pre-crossing fraction.

sentences.zh: 以一百一十二約之，為交時。

translations.literal: Reduce by one hundred twelve—that is crossing double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 112—that gives the crossing double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求月蝕所在辰術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the double-hour where lunar eclipse lies
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the double-hour where lunar eclipse lies

sentences.zh: 置望日不見刻，六十七乘之，十而一，所得，若蝕望定小餘與之等已下，又以此得減總法餘與之等已為蝕正見數定小餘。

translations.literal: Set full-moon day invisible marks; multiply by sixty-seven; divide by ten—the result: if eclipse full-moon fixed small remainder equals it or below, also use this result to subtract from common-divisor remainder and when equal or below that is eclipse true-visibility fixed small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Set the full-moon day's invisible marks; multiply by sixty-seven and divide by ten—the result: if the eclipse full-moon fixed small remainder equals it or is below, also use this result to subtract from the common-divisor remainder and when equal or below, that is the eclipse true-visibility fixed small remainder.

sentences.zh: 如求律氣應加時法，得加時所在辰月在沖辰蝕，若非正見者，於日出後日沒前十二刻半內，求其初末以候之。

translations.literal: Like the procedure for finding pitch-pipe qi response added double-hour, obtain added double-hour where it lies; Moon in opposing double-hour at eclipse; if not true visibility, within twelve and a half marks after sunrise or before sunset seek initial and final to await it.
translations.idiomatic: As in the procedure for finding the pitch-pipe qi response added double-hour, obtain the added double-hour where it lies; the Moon in the opposing double-hour at eclipse; if not true visibility, within twelve and a half marks after sunrise or before sunset seek the initial and final moments to await it.

sentences.zh: 又以半總減蝕定小餘，不足減者半總加減訖，以六乘之，如辰率而一，命起子半算外，即月蝕所在辰。

translations.literal: Also subtract eclipse fixed small remainder by half common divisor; when insufficient to subtract, add half common divisor and subtract when done; multiply by six; divide by double-hour rate; assign beginning from zi half beyond count—that is double-hour where lunar eclipse lies.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the eclipse fixed small remainder by half the common divisor; when insufficient to subtract, add the half common divisor and subtract when done; multiply by six; divide by the double-hour rate; assign beginning from zi at the half-interval beyond the count—that is the double-hour where lunar eclipse lies.

sentences.zh: 求日蝕所在辰術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the double-hour where solar eclipse lies
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the double-hour where solar eclipse lies

sentences.zh: 置有蝕朔定小餘副之，以辰率除之，所得以艮、坤、巽、乾為次，命退算外。

translations.literal: Set eclipsing new-moon fixed small remainder aside; divide by double-hour rate; take gen, kun, xun, qian in sequence; assign retreat beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Set the eclipsing new-moon fixed small remainder aside; divide by the double-hour rate; take gen, kun, xun, qian in sequence; assign retreat beyond the count.

sentences.zh: 不滿法者，半法減之。

translations.literal: When not full of divisor, subtract half divisor.
translations.idiomatic: When not full of the divisor, subtract half the divisor.

sentences.zh: 無可減者，為初；

translations.literal: When nothing can be subtracted, that is initial;
translations.idiomatic: When nothing can be subtracted, that is initial;

sentences.zh: 所減之餘，為末。

translations.literal: Remainder after subtraction, that is final.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder after subtraction is final.

sentences.zh: 初則減法，各為差率。

translations.literal: If initial then subtract divisor; each is difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If initial, subtract the divisor; each gives the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 月在內道者，乃以十加去交時數而三除之，以乘差率，十四而一，為差。

translations.literal: When Moon is on inner path, then add ten to distance-from-crossing double-hour count and divide by three; multiply by difference rate; divide by fourteen—that is difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is on the inner path, add ten to the distance-from-crossing double-hour count and divide by three; multiply by the difference rate and divide by fourteen—that is the difference.

sentences.zh: 其朔在二分前後一氣內，即以差為定。

translations.literal: When new moon is within one qi before or after either equinox, use difference as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: When the new moon falls within one qi before or after either equinox, use the difference as fixed.

sentences.zh: 近冬至以去寒露雨水、近夏至以去清明白露氣數倍之，又三除去交時數增之。

translations.literal: Near winter solstice use distance from Cold Dew and Rain Water; near summer solstice use distance from Clear and Bright and White Dew; multiply qi count; also increase by three-tenths removal of distance-from-crossing double-hour count.
translations.idiomatic: Near the winter solstice use the distance from Cold Dew and Rain Water; near the summer solstice use the distance from Clear and Bright and White Dew; multiply the qi count; also increase by three-tenths of the distance-from-crossing double-hour count.

sentences.zh: 近冬至，艮巽以加，坤乾以減；

translations.literal: Near winter solstice gen and xun add, kun and qian subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Near the winter solstice gen and xun add and kun and qian subtract;

sentences.zh: 近夏至，艮巽以減、坤乾以加其差，為定差。

translations.literal: Near summer solstice gen and xun subtract, kun and qian add to difference—that is fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Near the summer solstice gen and xun subtract and kun and qian add to the difference—that is the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 艮坤加副，巽乾減副。

translations.literal: Gen and kun add to aside; xun and qian subtract from aside.
translations.idiomatic: Gen and kun add to the aside; xun and qian subtract from the aside.

sentences.zh: 月在外道者，三除去交時數，以乘差率，十四而一，為之差。

translations.literal: When Moon is on outer path, reduce distance-from-crossing double-hour count by three-tenths; multiply by difference rate; divide by fourteen—that is difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is on the outer path, reduce the distance-from-crossing double-hour count by three-tenths; multiply by the difference rate and divide by fourteen—that is the difference.

sentences.zh: 艮坤以減副，巽乾以加副，各加減副訖，為定副小餘。

translations.literal: Gen and kun subtract from aside; xun and qian add to aside; when each addition and subtraction to aside is done, that is fixed aside small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Gen and kun subtract from the aside and xun and qian add to the aside; when all additions and subtractions to the aside are done, that is the fixed aside small remainder.

sentences.zh: 如求律氣應加時術，即日蝕所在辰及少太。

translations.literal: Like the procedure for finding pitch-pipe qi response added double-hour procedure, then the double-hour where solar eclipse lies and minor and major [degree].
translations.idiomatic: As in the procedure for finding the pitch-pipe qi response added double-hour, obtain the double-hour where the solar eclipse lies and its minor and major degree.

sentences.zh: 其求入辰刻，以半辰刻乘朔，辰率而一，得刻及分。

translations.literal: For finding entry double-hour marks: multiply new moon by half double-hour marks; divide by double-hour rate; obtain marks and fractions.
translations.idiomatic: To find the entry double-hour marks: multiply the new moon by half the double-hour marks, divide by the double-hour rate, and obtain marks and fractions.

sentences.zh: 若蝕近朝夕者，以朔所入氣日出沒刻校蝕所在，知蝕見不之多少，所在辰為正見日月蝕既，在起復初末，亦或變常退於見前後十二刻半候之。

translations.literal: If eclipse is near morning or evening, use new moon entering qi sunrise and sunset marks to verify eclipse position, knowing eclipse visibility or non-visibility amount; double-hour where it lies is true visibility for total solar or lunar eclipse; at emergence and restoration initial and final, it may also vary from norm and retreat twelve and a half marks before or after visibility to await it.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse falls near dawn or dusk, use the new moon's entering qi sunrise and sunset marks to verify the eclipse position and determine how visible it will be; the double-hour where it lies is true visibility for a total solar or lunar eclipse; at emergence and restoration, initial and final moments may also deviate from the norm—retreat twelve and a half marks before or after visibility to await it.

sentences.zh: 求月起復依蝕分後術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding lunar emergence and restoration according to eclipse fraction, following [earlier procedure]
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding lunar emergence and restoration according to eclipse fraction, following the procedure above

sentences.zh: 求月在日道表朔不應蝕准。

translations.literal: Procedure for criterion when new moon with Moon on sun-path outer side should not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the criterion when a new moon with the Moon on the outer side of the sun's path should not eclipse

sentences.zh: 朔在夏至初日，准去交前後二百四十八分為初准；

translations.literal: When new moon is on summer solstice first day, criterion: distance from crossing before or after two hundred forty-eight fractions is initial criterion;
translations.idiomatic: When the new moon falls on the first day of summer solstice, the criterion is: a distance from the crossing before or after of 248 fractions is the initial criterion;

sentences.zh: 已下，加時在午正前後七刻內者，食。

translations.literal: Below that, if added double-hour is within seven marks before or after noon culmination—eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: below that, if the added double-hour falls within seven marks before or after noon culmination, there is an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 朔去夏至前後，每一日損初准二分，畢於前後九十四日，各為每日變准。

translations.literal: New moon distance from summer solstice before or after: each day reduce initial criterion two fractions; completed at ninety-four days before or after; each becomes daily variable criterion.
translations.idiomatic: For the new moon's distance from summer solstice before or after, each day reduce the initial criterion by two fractions; this completes at ninety-four days before or after, each becoming a daily variable criterion.

sentences.zh: 其朔去交如變准已下，加時如前者，蝕。

translations.literal: When new moon distance from crossing is at variable criterion or below, added double-hour as above—eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When the new moon's distance from the crossing is at the variable criterion or below, and the added double-hour is as above, there is an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 又以末准六十減初准及變准，餘以十八約之，為刻准。

translations.literal: Also subtract initial and variable criterion by final criterion sixty; reduce remainder by eighteen—that is mark criterion.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the initial and variable criterion by the final criterion of 60; divide the remainder by 18—that is the mark criterion.

sentences.zh: 以並午正前後七刻數為時准。

translations.literal: Take combined seven marks before or after noon culmination count as time criterion.
translations.idiomatic: Take the combined count of seven marks before or after noon culmination as the time criterion.

sentences.zh: 加時准內去交分，如末准已下，並蝕。

translations.literal: Distance-from-crossing fraction within added double-hour criterion: at final criterion or below—both eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When the distance-from-crossing fraction is within the added double-hour criterion and at the final criterion or below, both conditions indicate eclipse.

sentences.zh: 又置末准，每一刻加十八，為差准。

translations.literal: Also set final criterion: each mark adds eighteen—that is difference criterion.
translations.idiomatic: Also set the final criterion: each mark adds 18—that is the difference criterion.

sentences.zh: 每加時刻，去午前後如差准刻已下，去交分如差已下者，並蝕。

translations.literal: Each added double-hour mark: distance from noon before or after at difference-criterion marks or below; distance-from-crossing fraction at difference or below—both eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: For each added double-hour mark: if the distance from noon before or after is at the difference-criterion marks or below, and the distance-from-crossing fraction is at the difference or below, both indicate eclipse.

sentences.zh: 自秋分至春分，去交如末准已下，加時南方三辰者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: From autumn equinox to spring equinox: distance from crossing at final criterion or below; added double-hour in three southern double-hours—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: From autumn equinox to spring equinox: if the distance from the crossing is at the final criterion or below and the added double-hour falls in the three southern double-hours, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 凡定交分在辰前後半時外者，雖入蝕准前為蝕。

translations.literal: Whenever fixed crossing fraction is outside half a double-hour before or after the double-hour, even if entering eclipse criterion before—that is eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the fixed crossing fraction lies outside half a double-hour before or after the double-hour, even if it enters the eclipse criterion beforehand, that counts as eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求月在日道里朔應蝕而不蝕准。

translations.literal: Procedure for criterion when new moon with Moon on sun-path inner side should eclipse but does not.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the criterion when a new moon with the Moon on the inner side of the sun's path should eclipse but does not

sentences.zh: 朔在夏至日，去交一千三百七十三，為初准；

translations.literal: New moon on summer solstice day: distance from crossing one thousand three hundred seventy-three—that is initial criterion;
translations.idiomatic: On summer solstice day at new moon: a distance from the crossing of 1,373 is the initial criterion;

sentences.zh: 已上，加時在午正前後十八刻內者，或不蝕。

translations.literal: Above that, added double-hour within eighteen marks before or after noon culmination—may not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: above that, if the added double-hour falls within eighteen marks before or after noon culmination, there may be no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 朔去夏至前後，每一日益初准一分半，畢於前後九十四日，各為每日變准。

translations.literal: New moon distance from summer solstice before or after: each day increase initial criterion one and a half fractions; completed at ninety-four days before or after; each becomes daily variable criterion.
translations.idiomatic: For the new moon's distance from summer solstice before or after, each day increase the initial criterion by one and a half fractions; this completes at ninety-four days before or after, each becoming a daily variable criterion.

sentences.zh: 以初減變，餘十而一，為刻准。

translations.literal: Subtract variable from initial; remainder divide by ten—that is mark criterion.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the variable from the initial; divide the remainder by ten—that is the mark criterion.

sentences.zh: 以刻減午正前後十八刻，餘，十而一為時准。

translations.literal: Subtract marks from eighteen marks before or after noon culmination; remainder divide by ten—that is time criterion.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the marks from eighteen marks before or after noon culmination; divide the remainder by ten—that is the time criterion.

sentences.zh: 其去交在變准已上，加時在准內者，或不蝕。

translations.literal: Distance from crossing above variable criterion; added double-hour within criterion—may not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When the distance from the crossing is above the variable criterion and the added double-hour falls within the criterion, there may be no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求月蝕分術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding lunar eclipse fraction
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding lunar eclipse fraction

sentences.zh: 置去交前後定分，冬交前後，皆去二百二十四。

translations.literal: Set fixed distance-from-crossing before or after fraction; winter crossing before or after—each subtract two hundred twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed distance-from-crossing before or after fraction; for winter crossing before or after, each subtract 224.

sentences.zh: 春交後去一百，交前去二百。

translations.literal: Spring: after crossing subtract one hundred; before crossing subtract two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In spring: after the crossing subtract 100; before the crossing subtract 200.

sentences.zh: 夏不問前後，去五十。

translations.literal: Summer regardless of before or after: subtract fifty.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, regardless of before or after: subtract 50.

sentences.zh: 秋交後去二百，交前去一百。

translations.literal: Autumn: after crossing subtract two hundred; before crossing subtract one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn: after the crossing subtract 200; before the crossing subtract 100.

sentences.zh: 不足去者，蝕既。

translations.literal: When insufficient to subtract—total eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When insufficient to subtract, it is a total eclipse.

sentences.zh: 有餘者，以減後准，一百四而一。

translations.literal: When there is remainder, subtract from rear criterion; divide by one hundred four.
translations.idiomatic: When there is a remainder, subtract from the rear criterion and divide by 104.

sentences.zh: 餘半已下，為半弱；

translations.literal: Remainder half divisor or below—half-weak;
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is half the divisor or below, it is half-weak;

sentences.zh: 半已上，為半強。

translations.literal: Half divisor or above—half-strong.
translations.idiomatic: if half the divisor or above, it is half-strong.

sentences.zh: 命以十五為限，得月蝕之大分。

translations.literal: Assign with fifteen as limit—obtain major lunar eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Assign with fifteen as the limit to obtain the major lunar eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 求月蝕所起術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding where lunar eclipse begins
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding where lunar eclipse begins

sentences.zh: 月在內道：蝕東方三辰，虧自月下斜南上，月從西而漸北，自東而漸南。

translations.literal: Moon on inner path: eclipse in eastern three double-hours, waning begins from below moon slanting south upward; moon from west gradually north, from east gradually south.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is on the inner path: in an eclipse of the eastern three double-hours, obscuration begins from below the moon slanting southward and upward; the moon moves from west gradually northward, from east gradually southward.

sentences.zh: 蝕南方三辰，虧起左下，甚于正南，復於右下。

translations.literal: Eclipse in southern three double-hours, waning begins lower left, greatest at due south, again at lower right.
translations.idiomatic: In an eclipse of the southern three double-hours, obscuration begins at the lower left, reaches greatest at due south, and again at the lower right.

sentences.zh: 蝕西方三辰。

translations.literal: Eclipse in western three double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: In an eclipse of the western three double-hours:

sentences.zh: 虧自南而漸東，月從北而漸西，起於月上，斜南而下。

translations.literal: Waning from south gradually east; moon from north gradually west; begins above moon, slanting south downward.
translations.idiomatic: obscuration proceeds from south gradually eastward; the moon from north gradually westward; it begins above the moon, slanting southward and downward.

sentences.zh: 月在外道：蝕東方三辰，虧起自月下，斜北而上，虧起東而漸北，月從西漸南。

translations.literal: Moon on outer path: eclipse in eastern three double-hours, waning begins from below moon slanting north upward; waning begins east gradually north, moon from west gradually south.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is on the outer path: in an eclipse of the eastern three double-hours, obscuration begins from below the moon slanting northward and upward; obscuration begins east gradually northward, the moon from west gradually southward.

sentences.zh: 蝕南方三辰，虧起左上，甚於正北，復於右上。

translations.literal: Eclipse in southern three double-hours, waning begins upper left, greatest at due north, again at upper right.
translations.idiomatic: In an eclipse of the southern three double-hours, obscuration begins at the upper left, reaches greatest at due north, and again at the upper right.

sentences.zh: 蝕西方三辰。

translations.literal: Eclipse in western three double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: In an eclipse of the western three double-hours:

sentences.zh: 虧自北而漸東，月從南而漸西，起於月上，斜北而上。

translations.literal: Waning from north gradually east; moon from south gradually west; begins above moon, slanting north upward.
translations.idiomatic: obscuration proceeds from north gradually eastward; the moon from south gradually westward; it begins above the moon, slanting northward and upward.

sentences.zh: 凡蝕十二分已上，皆隨黃道所在起復，於正傍逆順上下每過其分。

translations.literal: Whenever eclipse is twelve parts or above, all follow ecliptic position for emergence and restoration; at due flank reverse and direct, above and below each passing its fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the eclipse is twelve parts or above, emergence and restoration all follow the ecliptic position; at due flank, reverse and direct, above and below—each passing its fraction.

sentences.zh: 又道有升降，每各不同，各隨時取正。

translations.literal: Also the path has ascent and descent; each differs; each follows the time to take due position.
translations.idiomatic: The path also has ascent and descent, each differing; each follows the time to take the due position.

sentences.zh: 求日蝕分術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding solar eclipse fraction
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding solar eclipse fraction

sentences.zh: 月在內道者，朔入冬至，畢朒雨水，及盈秋分，畢大雪，皆以五百五十八為蝕差。

translations.literal: When Moon is on inner path: new moon entering winter solstice through waning Rain Water, and waxing autumn equinox through Great Snow—all use five hundred fifty-eight as eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is on the inner path: from new moon entering winter solstice through waning Rain Water, and from waxing autumn equinox through Great Snow—all use 558 as the eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 自入朒春分已後，日損六分，畢于白露。

translations.literal: From entering waning spring equinox afterward, each day reduce six fractions; completed at White Dew.
translations.idiomatic: From entering waning spring equinox onward, each day reduce six fractions until completed at White Dew.

sentences.zh: 置蝕去交前後定分，皆以蝕差減之。

translations.literal: Set eclipse distance-from-crossing before or after fixed fraction; all subtract by eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the eclipse distance-from-crossing before or after fixed fraction; subtract the eclipse difference from all.

sentences.zh: 但去交分不足減者，皆反以減蝕差為不蝕餘。

translations.literal: But when distance-from-crossing fraction is insufficient to subtract, all inversely subtract eclipse difference as non-eclipse remainder.
translations.idiomatic: But when the distance-from-crossing fraction is insufficient to subtract, inversely subtract the eclipse difference as the non-eclipse remainder.

sentences.zh: 自入朒小滿，畢盈小暑，加時在午正前後七刻外者，皆去不蝕餘一時；

translations.literal: From entering waning Minor Fullness through waxing Minor Heat, added double-hour outside seven marks before or after noon culmination—all subtract one time from non-eclipse remainder;
translations.idiomatic: From entering waning Minor Fullness through waxing Minor Heat, if the added double-hour falls outside seven marks before or after noon culmination, subtract one time from the non-eclipse remainder;

sentences.zh: 三刻內，加不蝕餘一時。

translations.literal: Within three marks, add one time to non-eclipse remainder.
translations.idiomatic: within three marks, add one time to the non-eclipse remainder.

sentences.zh: 朒大寒畢朒立春，交前五時外，大暑畢盈立冬，交後五時外，皆去不蝕餘一時，五時內加一時。

translations.literal: Waning Great Cold through waning Start of Spring, five times before crossing outside; Great Heat through waxing Start of Winter, five times after crossing outside—all subtract one time from non-eclipse remainder; within five times add one time.
translations.idiomatic: From waning Great Cold through waning Start of Spring, outside five times before the crossing; from Great Heat through waxing Start of Winter, outside five times after the crossing—all subtract one time from the non-eclipse remainder; within five times add one time.

sentences.zh: 諸加時蝕差應減者，交後減之，交前加之。

translations.literal: For all added double-hour eclipse differences that should be subtracted: after crossing subtract; before crossing add.
translations.idiomatic: For all added double-hour eclipse differences that should be subtracted: after the crossing subtract; before the crossing add.

sentences.zh: 應加者，交後加之，交前減之。

translations.literal: Those that should be added: after crossing add; before crossing subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Those that should be added: after the crossing add; before the crossing subtract.

sentences.zh: 但不足減去者，蝕既。

translations.literal: But when insufficient to subtract—total eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: But when insufficient to subtract, it is a total eclipse.

sentences.zh: 加減入不蝕限者，或不蝕。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction enter non-eclipse limit—may not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When addition and subtraction enter the non-eclipse limit, there may be no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其月在外道者，冬至初日無蝕差。

translations.literal: When Moon is on outer path: winter solstice first day has no eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is on the outer path: the winter solstice first day has no eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 自後日益六分，累計以為蝕差，畢于朒雨水。

translations.literal: From afterward each day increase six fractions; accumulate as eclipse difference; completed at waning Rain Water.
translations.idiomatic: From then on each day increase six fractions, accumulating as the eclipse difference until completed at waning Rain Water.

sentences.zh: 自入朒春分，畢于盈白露，皆以五百二十二為蝕差。

translations.literal: From entering waning spring equinox through waxing White Dew—all use five hundred twenty-two as eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: From entering waning spring equinox through waxing White Dew—all use 522 as the eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 自入盈秋分已後，日損六分，畢于大雪。

translations.literal: From entering waxing autumn equinox afterward, each day reduce six fractions; completed at Great Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From entering waxing autumn equinox onward, each day reduce six fractions until completed at Great Snow.

sentences.zh: 所損之餘，為蝕差。

translations.literal: Remainder after reduction—that is eclipse difference.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder after reduction is the eclipse difference.

sentences.zh: 以蝕差加去交定分，為蝕分。

translations.literal: Add eclipse difference to distance-from-crossing fixed fraction—that is eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Add the eclipse difference to the distance-from-crossing fixed fraction—that is the eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 以減後准，餘為不蝕分。

translations.literal: Subtract from rear criterion; remainder is non-eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the rear criterion; the remainder is the non-eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 各置其朔蝕差，十五約之，以減一百四，餘為定法。

translations.literal: Each set its new-moon eclipse difference; reduce by fifteen; subtract from one hundred four; remainder is fixed divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Set each new-moon eclipse difference; divide by fifteen; subtract from 104; the remainder is the fixed divisor.

sentences.zh: 不蝕分餘，各如定法得一分。

translations.literal: Non-eclipse fraction remainder: each as fixed divisor obtains one part.
translations.idiomatic: For the non-eclipse fraction remainder: each division by the fixed divisor obtains one part.

sentences.zh: 餘半法已上，為半強；

translations.literal: Remainder half divisor or above—half-strong;
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is half the divisor or above, it is half-strong;

sentences.zh: 已下，為半弱。

translations.literal: Below—half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: below, it is half-weak.

sentences.zh: 減十五，餘為蝕之大分。

translations.literal: Subtract fifteen; remainder is major eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract fifteen; the remainder is the major eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 求日蝕所起術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding where solar eclipse begins
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding where solar eclipse begins

sentences.zh: 日在內道：日蝕東方三辰，虧自日上近北而斜下，月漸西北，日漸東南。

translations.literal: Sun on inner path: solar eclipse in eastern three double-hours, waning from above sun near north slanting down; moon gradually northwest, sun gradually southeast.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sun is on the inner path: in a solar eclipse of the eastern three double-hours, obscuration begins from above the sun near north slanting downward; the moon moves gradually northwest, the sun gradually southeast.

sentences.zh: 日蝕南方三辰，虧起右下，甚正北，復左下。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse in southern three double-hours, waning begins lower right, greatest at due north, again lower left.
translations.idiomatic: In a solar eclipse of the southern three double-hours, obscuration begins at the lower right, reaches greatest at due north, and again at the lower left.

sentences.zh: 月在南而漸東，日在北而漸西。

translations.literal: Moon in south gradually east; sun in north gradually west.
translations.idiomatic: The moon is in the south gradually eastward; the sun in the north gradually westward.

sentences.zh: 日蝕西方三辰。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse in western three double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: In a solar eclipse of the western three double-hours:

sentences.zh: 月漸東北，日漸西南，虧自日下近西而斜上。

translations.literal: Moon gradually northeast, sun gradually southwest, waning from below sun near west slanting up.
translations.idiomatic: the moon moves gradually northeast, the sun gradually southwest; obscuration begins from below the sun near west slanting upward.

sentences.zh: 日在外道：日蝕東方三辰，虧自日上近南而斜下，月漸東南，日漸西北。

translations.literal: Sun on outer path: solar eclipse in eastern three double-hours, waning from above sun near south slanting down; moon gradually southeast, sun gradually northwest.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sun is on the outer path: in a solar eclipse of the eastern three double-hours, obscuration begins from above the sun near south slanting downward; the moon moves gradually southeast, the sun gradually northwest.

sentences.zh: 日蝕南方三辰，虧起右下，甚正北，復左下。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse in southern three double-hours, waning begins lower right, greatest at due north, again lower left.
translations.idiomatic: In a solar eclipse of the southern three double-hours, obscuration begins at the lower right, reaches greatest at due north, and again at the lower left.

sentences.zh: 月在南而漸東，日在北而漸西。

translations.literal: Moon in south gradually east; sun in north gradually west.
translations.idiomatic: The moon is in the south gradually eastward; the sun in the north gradually westward.

sentences.zh: 日蝕西方三辰。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse in western three double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: In a solar eclipse of the western three double-hours:

sentences.zh: 月漸西南，日漸東北，虧自日下近南而斜上。

translations.literal: Moon gradually southwest, sun gradually northeast, waning from below sun near south slanting up.
translations.idiomatic: the moon moves gradually southwest, the sun gradually northeast; obscuration begins from below the sun near south slanting upward.

sentences.zh: 凡蝕十二分已上，起於正旁。

translations.literal: Whenever eclipse is twelve parts or above, begins at due flank.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the eclipse is twelve parts or above, it begins at the due flank.

sentences.zh: 各據黃道升降，以准其體。

translations.literal: Each according to ecliptic ascent and descent to gauge its body.
translations.idiomatic: Each follows the ecliptic's ascent and descent to gauge its disk.

sentences.zh: 隨其所處，每各不同。

translations.literal: Following where it lies, each differs.
translations.idiomatic: Following where each lies, all differ.

sentences.zh: 蝕有初末，動涉其時，隨便益損，以定虧復所在之方也。

translations.literal: Eclipse has initial and final; movement touches its time; as convenient increase and decrease, to fix waning and restoration direction.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipses have initial and final moments; their movement spans its time; increase and decrease as needed to fix the direction of obscuration and restoration.

sentences.zh: 求日月蝕虧初及復末時刻術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding solar and lunar eclipse waning initial and restoration final moments
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the moments of eclipse waning initial and restoration final

sentences.zh: 置朔望所蝕大分數為率。

translations.literal: Set new and full moon eclipse major fraction count as rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the new and full moon eclipse major fraction count as the rate.

sentences.zh: 四分已上，因增二。

translations.literal: Four parts or above, accordingly increase two.
translations.idiomatic: Four parts or above: accordingly increase by two.

sentences.zh: 五分已上，因增三。

translations.literal: Five parts or above, accordingly increase three.
translations.idiomatic: Five parts or above: accordingly increase by three.

sentences.zh: 九分已上，因增四。

translations.literal: Nine parts or above, accordingly increase four.
translations.idiomatic: Nine parts or above: accordingly increase by four.

sentences.zh: 十三分已上，因增五。

translations.literal: Thirteen parts or above, accordingly increase five.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen parts or above: accordingly increase by five.

sentences.zh: 各為泛用刻率，副之。

translations.literal: Each becomes general-use mark rate; set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Each becomes a general-use mark rate; set it aside.

sentences.zh: 以乘所入率，副之。

translations.literal: Multiply by entered rate; set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the entered rate; set aside.

sentences.zh: 以乘所入變增減率，總法而一，應速增損、減加，應遲依其增減副，訖，為蝕定用刻數。

translations.literal: Multiply by entered change increase-decrease rate; divide by common divisor; when fast increase-decrease, subtract-add; when slow follow its increase-decrease aside; when done, that is fixed eclipse-use mark count.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the entered change increase-decrease rate; divide by the common divisor; when fast, increase or decrease and subtract or add; when slow, follow its increase-decrease to the aside; when done, that is the fixed eclipse-use mark count.

sentences.zh: 乃四乘之，十而一，以減蝕甚辰刻，為虧初。

translations.literal: Then multiply by four; divide by ten; subtract from maximum eclipse double-hour marks—that is waning initial.
translations.idiomatic: Then multiply by four and divide by ten; subtract from the maximum eclipse double-hour marks—that is waning initial.

sentences.zh: 又六乘之，十而一，加蝕甚辰刻，為復末。

translations.literal: Also multiply by six; divide by ten; add to maximum eclipse double-hour marks—that is restoration final.
translations.idiomatic: Also multiply by six and divide by ten; add to the maximum eclipse double-hour marks—that is restoration final.

sentences.zh: 依其定加時所在辰刻加減命之，各其辰、其月蝕甚初末更籌。

translations.literal: According to its fixed added double-hour where it lies in double-hour marks, add and subtract to assign; each its double-hour; lunar eclipse maximum initial and final night-watch tallies.
translations.idiomatic: According to its fixed added double-hour position in double-hour marks, add and subtract to assign; each to its double-hour; the lunar eclipse maximum initial and final night-watch tallies.

sentences.zh: 因其日月所入辰刻及分，依前定氣所遇夜刻更籌術，求其初末及甚時更籌。

translations.literal: Following its sun and moon entered double-hour marks and fractions, according to prior fixed qi encountered night-mark night-watch tally procedure, find its initial and final and maximum night-watch tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Following the sun and moon's entered double-hour marks and fractions, according to the prior fixed qi night-mark night-watch tally procedure, find the initial, final, and maximum night-watch tallies.

sentences.zh: 迦葉孝威等天竺法，先依日月行遲疾度，以推入交遠近日月蝕分加時，日月蝕亦為十五分。

translations.literal: Kāśyapa Xiaowei and others' Indian method: first according to sun and moon slow-fast degrees, to derive crossing-entry distance from sun and moon eclipse fraction added double-hour; solar and lunar eclipses also use fifteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: The Indian method of Kāśyapa Xiaowei and others: first according to the sun and moon's slow and fast degrees, derive the crossing-entry distance, eclipse fraction, and added double-hour; solar and lunar eclipses also use fifteen parts.

sentences.zh: 去交十五度、十四度、十三度，影虧不蝕法，自此已下，乃依驗蝕。

translations.literal: Distance from crossing fifteen, fourteen, thirteen degrees—shadow waning without eclipse method; from here below, then rely on verified eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At distances from the crossing of fifteen, fourteen, and thirteen degrees—the shadow-waning non-eclipse method applies; from here below, one then relies on verified eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二度十五分，蝕二分少強，以漸差降，自五度半已上，蝕既，十四分強。

translations.literal: Twelve degrees fifteen parts—eclipse two parts minor-strong; gradually decreasing by difference; from five and a half degrees above—total eclipse, fourteen parts strong.
translations.idiomatic: At twelve degrees fifteen parts—an eclipse of two parts minor-strong, gradually decreasing by difference; from five and a half degrees above—a total eclipse of fourteen parts strong.

sentences.zh: 若五度無餘分已下，皆蝕盡。

translations.literal: If five degrees with no remainder below—all eclipsed entirely.
translations.idiomatic: If five degrees with no remainder below, all is entirely eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 又用前蝕多少，以定後蝕分餘。

translations.literal: Also use how much the prior eclipse was, to fix the later eclipse fraction remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Also use the magnitude of the prior eclipse to fix the fraction remainder of the next.

sentences.zh: 若既，其後蝕度及分，即加七度以為蝕度。

translations.literal: If total, its later eclipse degree and parts—then add seven degrees as the eclipse degree.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse was total, add seven degrees to its later eclipse degree and parts to obtain the eclipse degree.

sentences.zh: 若望月蝕既，來月朔日雖入而不注蝕。

translations.literal: If full-moon eclipse is total, next month new-moon day although entering [criterion] is not registered for eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If a full-moon eclipse is total, the next month's new moon may enter the criterion yet is not registered as an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 若蝕半已下，五分取一分；

translations.literal: If eclipse is half or below, from five parts take one part;
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse is half or less, take one part in five;

sentences.zh: 若半已上，三分取一分，以加來月朔蝕度及分。

translations.literal: If half or above, from three parts take one part, to add to next month new-moon eclipse degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: if half or more, take one part in three and add it to the next month's new-moon eclipse degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 若今歲日餘度及分，然後可驗蝕度分數多少。

translations.literal: If the current year's solar remainder degree and parts, then one may verify how much the eclipse degree fraction is.
translations.idiomatic: Once the current year's solar remainder in degrees and parts is set, one may then verify the eclipse degree and fraction.

sentences.zh: 又云：六月依節一蝕。

translations.literal: It also says: every six months according to the node, one eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: It also states that, by the nodes, there is one eclipse every six months.

sentences.zh: 是月十五日是月蝕節，黑月儘是月蝕節，亦以吉凶之象，警告王者奉順正法，蒼生福盛，雖時應蝕，由福故也，其蝕即退。

translations.literal: That month's fifteenth day is the full-moon eclipse node; the dark moon entirely is the full-moon eclipse node—also by auspicious and inauspicious signs warning the king to follow the correct law; when the people are greatly blessed, although an eclipse is due in season, because of blessing it retreats.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth of that month is the full-moon eclipse node; the dark of the moon is wholly the full-moon eclipse node. These omens of fortune and misfortune warn the king to uphold the righteous law: when the people are deeply blessed, though an eclipse is seasonally due, it retreats for that very blessing.

sentences.zh: 更經六月，欲蝕之前，皆有先兆。

translations.literal: After another six months pass, before an eclipse is due, there are always foretokens.
translations.idiomatic: Six months later, before an eclipse is due, there are always foretokens.

sentences.zh: 月欲有蝕，先月形搖振，狀若驚懼，月兔及側月色黃如有憂狀。

translations.literal: When the moon is about to eclipse, first the moon's form trembles and shakes, appearing as if alarmed; the moon rabbit and the moon's side turn yellow as if in grief.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon is about to be eclipsed, its disk first trembles and shakes as if in alarm; the hare in the moon and the moon's limb turn yellow, as though stricken with grief.

sentences.zh: 自常暈，月初生時，光不顯盛，或極細微。

translations.literal: From the usual halo, at the month's first waxing, light does not appear bright, or is extremely faint.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from its usual halo, at first waxing the light does not blaze forth, or is exceedingly faint.

sentences.zh: 日欲有蝕，先日形搖振，極如驚懼狀。

translations.literal: When the sun is about to eclipse, first the sun's form trembles and shakes, extremely as if alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun is about to be eclipsed, its disk first trembles and shakes, as if in extreme alarm.

sentences.zh: 或光色微昧，不赫盛，或黎慘。

translations.literal: Or light and color are faint and dim, not blazing bright, or dusky and grim.
translations.idiomatic: Its light and color may grow faint and dim, no longer blazing bright, or turn dusky and grim.

sentences.zh: 日月蝕先同候，光隕墜，或旦暮際有赤色起，如火燒，金銀珠玉諸寶失光。

translations.literal: Solar and lunar eclipses share foretokens alike: light falls and drops; or at dawn and dusk margins red color rises like fire burning; gold, silver, pearls, jade, and all treasures lose their luster.
translations.idiomatic: Solar and lunar eclipses share the same foretokens: light falls away; at dawn or dusk a red glow rises as if afire; gold, silver, pearls, jade, and every treasure lose their luster.

sentences.zh: 或有闕盡如雲入日，或有黑盡入月，鳥聲細隱，烏不顯亮，雲交擾擾，光景渾亂，忽極令諸乳卒竭，月濕如汗狀，日形段裂無光，犬嗥貓叫，虹見有聲，三辰失闕，月時有缺，水赤色有膩。

translations.literal: Or there are gaps consumed as if clouds enter the sun, or blackness consumed enters the moon; bird cries thin and hidden, crows not bright; clouds cross in turmoil, light and aspect all confused; suddenly to the extreme making all nursing milk exhausted; moon damp as sweat; sun's form split in segments without light; dogs howl, cats cry; rainbow appears with sound; three luminaries lose parts; moon at times has gaps; water red-colored with greasy film.
translations.idiomatic: Gaps may be eaten away as though clouds swallowed the sun, or blackness swallowed the moon; birds cry thinly and hidden, crows lose their brightness; clouds tangle in turmoil and light grows wholly confused; suddenly, to the extreme, the milk of all nursing creatures fails; the moon grows damp as with sweat; the sun's disk splits segment by segment and goes dark; dogs howl and cats wail; a rainbow appears with sound; the three luminaries lose their wholeness; the moon at times shows gaps; water turns red and greasy.

sentences.zh: 十四日、十五日，辟鳥圓集者，亦是蝕之先候。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth and fifteenth days, warbler birds gathering in circles—this too is a foretoken of eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth and fifteenth days, warblers gathering in circles are also a foretoken of eclipse.

sentences.zh: 此等與中國法數稍殊，自外梗概相似也。

translations.literal: These and China's numerical methods differ slightly; in outline they are broadly similar.
translations.idiomatic: These differ slightly from China's numerical methods, yet in broad outline they are much the same.

sentences.zh: 步五星術

translations.literal: Procedure for stepping the five planets
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the Five Planets

sentences.zh: 見伏五十二日，晨見伏六十三日，餘、奇同終分奇。

translations.literal: Appearance-invisibility fifty-two days; morning appearance-invisibility sixty-three days; remainder and odd same as terminal fraction odd.
translations.idiomatic: Appearance-invisibility: 52 days; morning appearance-invisibility: 63 days; remainder and odd parts match the terminal fraction odd.

sentences.zh: 求五星平見術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the five planets' mean appearances
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding the Five Planets' Mean Appearances

sentences.zh: 各以伏分減總實，餘以其星總率去之。

translations.literal: Each use invisibility fraction to subtract from total remainder; with the remainder remove by that star's total rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, subtract the invisibility fraction from the accumulated remainder and divide the remainder by that star's total cycle rate.

sentences.zh: 不足去者，反減其餘總率。

translations.literal: If insufficient to remove, inversely subtract the remainder from total rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the division cannot be completed, subtract the remainder inversely from the total rate.

sentences.zh: 餘以總法約之，為日，不盡為餘奇，即所求年天正恆朔夜半後星晨夕平見日算及餘奇。

translations.literal: Reduce remainder by total factor to get days; undivided is remainder odd—that is the sought year's celestial first month mean new moon midnight after star morning/evening mean appearance day count and remainder odd.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the remainder by the total factor to obtain days; what remains undivided is the remainder odd—that gives the morning or evening mean appearance day count and remainder odd after midnight of the celestial first month's mean new moon for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 天正定朔進退日者，進減退加一日為定朔夜半後星平見日及餘奇。

translations.literal: When celestial first month fixed new moon advances or retreats a day, advance subtract retreat add one day for fixed new moon midnight after star mean appearance day and remainder odd.
translations.idiomatic: When the celestial first month's fixed new moon advances or retreats a day, subtract a day for advance and add a day for retreat to obtain the mean appearance day and remainder odd after midnight of the fixed new moon.

sentences.zh: 其金水二星，先得夕平見，其滿見伏日及餘者去之，餘為晨平見日及餘奇。

translations.literal: For Metal and Water two stars, first obtain evening mean appearance; remove what fills appearance-invisibility days and remainder; remainder is morning mean appearance day and remainder odd.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, first obtain the evening mean appearance; cast out the full appearance-invisibility days and remainder; the remainder is the morning mean appearance day and remainder odd.

sentences.zh: 命見日天正曆月大小，以次去之，不滿月者為入其月，命日算外，即晨夕平見所在月日及餘奇。

translations.literal: Assign from appearance day the celestial first month calendar month lengths, remove in sequence; what does not fill a month is entering that month; count outside day reckoning—that is morning/evening mean appearance's month, day, and remainder odd.
translations.idiomatic: From the appearance day, cast out full months according to the celestial first month calendar's long and short months; what does not fill a month is the month entered; count the day outside the reckoning—that gives the month, day, and remainder odd of the morning or evening mean appearance.

sentences.zh: 求後平見在月日術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding later mean appearance month and day
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding Later Mean Appearance Month and Day

sentences.zh: 各以其星終日算及餘奇，如前平見所在月日算及餘奇。

translations.literal: Each use that star's terminal day count and remainder odd, as prior mean appearance's month day count and remainder odd.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, add that star's terminal day count and remainder odd to the prior mean appearance's month, day count, and remainder odd.

sentences.zh: 奇滿奇率，從餘。

translations.literal: When odd fills odd rate, carry from remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the odd parts fill the odd rate, carry into the remainder.

sentences.zh: 餘滿總法，為日。

translations.literal: When remainder fills total factor, becomes days.
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder fills the total factor, convert it to days.

sentences.zh: 去命如前，即後平見所在月日及餘奇，其金水二星，加夕得晨，加晨得夕。

translations.literal: Remove and assign as before—that is later mean appearance's month, day, and remainder odd; for Metal and Water two stars, add evening obtains morning, add morning obtains evening.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out and assign as before to obtain the later mean appearance's month, day, and remainder odd; for Venus and Mercury, adding the evening date yields the morning, and adding the morning yields the evening.

sentences.zh: 各半見餘，以同半總。
