translations.literal: Each halve appearance remainder to match half-total.
translations.idiomatic: Halve each planet's appearance remainder to match the half-total.

sentences.zh: 求五星常見術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the five planets' regular appearances
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding the Five Planets' Regular Appearances

sentences.zh: 各依其星平見所入恆氣，計日損益。

translations.literal: Each according to its star's mean appearance entered mean qi, calculate daily diminish-increase.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, according to the mean qi entered at its mean appearance, calculate the daily diminish-increase.

sentences.zh: 分滿半總為日，不滿為分，以損益所加減。

translations.literal: When parts fill half-total becomes days; when not full is parts; use diminish-increase to add-subtract.
translations.idiomatic: When the parts fill the half-total, convert them to days; what does not fill remains as parts; apply the diminish-increase to add or subtract.

sentences.zh: 訖，餘以加減訖平見日及分，即其常見日及分。

translations.literal: When done, remainder used to add-subtract to completed mean appearance day and parts—that is its regular appearance day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: When this is done, apply the remainder to add or subtract from the completed mean appearance day and parts—that yields the regular appearance day and parts.

sentences.zh: 星日初見去日度，平見入氣曆。

translations.literal: Star day first appearance distance-from-sun degree; mean appearance entering qi calendar.
translations.idiomatic: At first appearance, distance from the sun in degrees; mean appearance entering-qi calendar.

sentences.zh: 加減日。

translations.literal: Add-subtract days.
translations.idiomatic: Add-subtract days.

sentences.zh: 損益率。

translations.literal: Diminish-increase rates.
translations.idiomatic: Diminish-increase rates.

sentences.zh: 歲星初見，去日十四度。

translations.literal: Jupiter at first appearance, fourteen degrees from the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter: at first appearance it stands fourteen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 見入冬至，畢小寒，均減六日。

translations.literal: At appearance entering Winter Solstice through Minor Cold, uniformly subtract six days.
translations.idiomatic: At mean appearance entering the Winter Solstice through Minor Cold, uniformly subtract six days.

sentences.zh: 自入大寒已後，日損六十七分。

translations.literal: From entering Major Cold afterward, daily subtract sixty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Cold onward, subtract 67 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 見入春分初日，依平。

translations.literal: At appearance entering Spring Equinox first day, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At mean appearance entering the Spring Equinox on the first day, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 自後日加八十九分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily add eighty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, add 89 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入立夏，畢小滿，均加六日。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Summer through Minor Fullness, uniformly add six days.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Summer through Minor Fullness, uniformly add six days.

sentences.zh: 自入芒種已後，日損八十九分。

translations.literal: From entering Grain in Ear afterward, daily subtract eighty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain in Ear onward, subtract 89 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入夏至，畢立秋，均加四日。

translations.literal: Entering Summer Solstice through Start of Autumn, uniformly add four days.
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice through the Start of Autumn, uniformly add four days.

sentences.zh: 自入處暑已後，日損一百七十八分。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat afterward, daily subtract one hundred seventy-eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat onward, subtract 178 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入白露，初日依平均，自後日減五十二分。

translations.literal: Entering White Dew, first day follow mean; from then daily subtract fifty-two parts.
translations.idiomatic: At White Dew, follow the mean rate on the first day; from then on, subtract 52 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入小雪，畢大雪，均減六日。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Snow through Major Snow, uniformly subtract six days.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow through Major Snow, uniformly subtract six days.

sentences.zh: 熒惑初見，去日十七度。

translations.literal: Mars at first appearance, seventeen degrees from the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Mars: at first appearance it stands seventeen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 見入冬至，初日減二十七日。

translations.literal: At appearance entering Winter Solstice, first day subtract twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: At mean appearance entering the Winter Solstice, subtract 27 days on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自後日損六百三分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily subtract six hundred three parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, subtract 603 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入大寒，初日依平。

translations.literal: Entering Major Cold, first day follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At Major Cold, follow the mean rate on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自後日加四百二分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily add four hundred two parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, add 402 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入雨水，畢穀雨，均加二十七日。

translations.literal: Entering Rain Water through Grain Rain, uniformly add twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: From Rain Water through Grain Rain, uniformly add 27 days.

sentences.zh: 入自立夏已後，日損一百九十八分。

translations.literal: From entering Start of Summer afterward, daily subtract one hundred ninety-eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Summer onward, subtract 198 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入立秋，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Autumn, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At the Start of Autumn, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 自入處暑已後，日減一百九十分。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat afterward, daily subtract one hundred ninety parts.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat onward, subtract 190 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入小雪，畢大寒，均減二十七日。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Snow through Major Cold, uniformly subtract twenty-seven days.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow through Major Cold, uniformly subtract 27 days.

sentences.zh: 鎮星初見，去日十七度。

translations.literal: Saturn at first appearance, seventeen degrees from the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn: at first appearance it stands seventeen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 見入冬至，初日減四日。

translations.literal: At appearance entering Winter Solstice, first day subtract four days.
translations.idiomatic: At mean appearance entering the Winter Solstice, subtract four days on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自後日益八十九分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily add eighty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, add 89 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入大寒，畢春分，均減八日。

translations.literal: Entering Major Cold through Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract eight days.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Cold through the Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract eight days.

sentences.zh: 自入清明已後，日損五十九分。

translations.literal: From entering Clear Brightness afterward, daily subtract fifty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Clear Brightness onward, subtract 59 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入小暑，初日依平。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Heat, first day follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At Minor Heat, follow the mean rate on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自後日加八十九分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily add eighty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, add 89 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入白露，初日加八日。

translations.literal: Entering White Dew, first day add eight days.
translations.idiomatic: At White Dew, add eight days on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自後日損一百七十八分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily subtract one hundred seventy-eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, subtract 178 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入秋分，均加四日。

translations.literal: Entering Autumn Equinox, uniformly add four days.
translations.idiomatic: At the Autumn Equinox, uniformly add four days.

sentences.zh: 自入寒露已後，日損五十九分。

translations.literal: From entering Cold Dew afterward, daily subtract fifty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Cold Dew onward, subtract 59 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入小雪，初日依平。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Snow, first day follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At Minor Snow, follow the mean rate on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自平後日減八十九分。

translations.literal: From after mean, daily subtract eighty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: From the mean rate onward, subtract 89 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 太白初見，去日十一度。

translations.literal: Venus at first appearance, eleven degrees from the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Venus: at first appearance it stands eleven degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 夕見：入冬至，初日依平。

translations.literal: Evening appearance: entering Winter Solstice, first day follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: Evening appearance: from the Winter Solstice, follow the mean rate on the first day.

sentences.zh: 自後日減一百分。

translations.literal: From then on, daily subtract one hundred parts.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, subtract 100 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入啟蟄，畢春分，均減九日。

translations.literal: Entering Awakening of Insects through Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From Awakening of Insects through the Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract nine days.

sentences.zh: 自入清明已後，日損一百分。

translations.literal: From entering Clear Brightness afterward, daily subtract one hundred parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Clear Brightness onward, subtract 100 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入芒種，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Grain in Ear, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At Grain in Ear, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至已後，日加一百分。

translations.literal: From entering Summer Solstice afterward, daily add one hundred parts.
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice onward, add 100 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入處暑，畢秋分，均加九日。

translations.literal: Entering End of Heat through Autumn Equinox, uniformly add nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through the Autumn Equinox, uniformly add nine days.

sentences.zh: 自入寒露已後，日損一百分。

translations.literal: From entering Cold Dew afterward, daily subtract one hundred parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Cold Dew onward, subtract 100 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入大雪，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Major Snow, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At Major Snow, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 晨見：入冬至，依平。

translations.literal: Morning appearance: entering Winter Solstice, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: Morning appearance: from the Winter Solstice, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 自入小寒已後，日加六十七分。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Cold afterward, daily add sixty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Cold onward, add 67 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入立春，畢立夏，均加三日。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Spring through Start of Summer, uniformly add three days.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Spring through the Start of Summer, uniformly add three days.

sentences.zh: 自入小滿已後，日損六十七分。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Fullness afterward, daily subtract sixty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness onward, subtract 67 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入夏至，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Summer Solstice, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: At the Summer Solstice, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 自入小暑已後，日減六十七分。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Heat afterward, daily subtract sixty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Heat onward, subtract 67 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 入立秋，畢立冬，均減三日。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Autumn through Start of Winter, uniformly subtract three days.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Autumn through the Start of Winter, uniformly subtract three days.

sentences.zh: 自入小雪已後，日損六十七分。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Snow afterward, daily subtract sixty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow onward, subtract 67 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 辰星初見，去日十七度。

translations.literal: Mercury at first appearance, seventeen degrees from the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury: at first appearance it stands seventeen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 夕見：入冬至，畢清明，依平。

translations.literal: Evening appearance: entering Winter Solstice through Clear Brightness, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: Evening appearance: from the Winter Solstice through Clear Brightness, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 入穀雨，畢芒種，均減二日。

translations.literal: Entering Grain Rain through Grain in Ear, uniformly subtract two days.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain Rain through Grain in Ear, uniformly subtract two days.

sentences.zh: 入夏至，畢大暑，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Summer Solstice through Major Heat, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice through Major Heat, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 入立秋，畢霜降，應見不見。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Autumn through Frost's Descent, should appear but does not appear.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Autumn through Frost's Descent, it should appear but does not.

sentences.zh: 其在立秋及霜降二氣之內，夕去日十八度外，三十六度內，有木火土金一星已上者亦見。

translations.literal: If within Start of Autumn and Frost's Descent two qi, evening distance from sun beyond eighteen degrees and within thirty-six degrees, if Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal one star or more also visible.
translations.idiomatic: If within the two qi of Start of Autumn and Frost's Descent, in the evening it stands more than eighteen degrees but less than thirty-six degrees from the sun, and Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, or Venus is also visible, it is seen as well.

sentences.zh: 入立冬，畢大雪，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Winter through Major Snow, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Winter through Major Snow, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 晨見：入冬至，均減四日。

translations.literal: Morning appearance: entering Winter Solstice, uniformly subtract four days.
translations.idiomatic: Morning appearance: from the Winter Solstice, uniformly subtract four days.

sentences.zh: 入小寒，畢大寒，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Cold through Major Cold, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Cold through Major Cold, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 入立春，畢啟蟄，均減三日。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Spring through Awakening of Insects, uniformly subtract three days.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Spring through Awakening of Insects, uniformly subtract three days.

sentences.zh: 其在啟蟄氣內，去日度如前，晨無木火土金，一星已上者不見。

translations.literal: If within Awakening of Insects qi, distance from sun in degrees as before—in the morning without Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal one star or more, is not seen.
translations.idiomatic: If within the Awakening of Insects qi, at the same solar distance as before, with no Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, or Venus visible in the morning, it is not seen.

sentences.zh: 入雨水，畢立夏，應見不見。

translations.literal: Entering Rain Water through Start of Summer, should appear but does not appear.
translations.idiomatic: From Rain Water through the Start of Summer, it should appear but does not.

sentences.zh: 其在立夏氣內，去日度如前，晨有木火土金一星已上者，亦見。

translations.literal: If within Start of Summer qi, distance from sun in degrees as before—in the morning with Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal one star or more also is seen.
translations.idiomatic: If within the Start of Summer qi, at the same solar distance as before, with one or more of Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, or Venus visible in the morning, it is seen as well.

sentences.zh: 入小滿，畢寒露，依平。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Fullness through Cold Dew, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness through Cold Dew, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 入露降，畢立冬，均加一日。

translations.literal: Entering White Dew and Frost's Descent through Start of Winter, uniformly add one day.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew and Frost's Descent through the Start of Winter, uniformly add one day.

translations.literal: Entering Minor Snow through Major Snow, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow through Major Snow, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 求五星定見術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the five planets' fixed appearances
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding the Five Planets' Fixed Appearances

sentences.zh: 各置其星常見日消息定數半之，息減消加常見日，即為定見日及分。

translations.literal: Each set that star's regular appearance day's correction constant and halve it; at rest diminish-increase the regular appearance day—that is the fixed appearance day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, take half of that star's daily correction constant at its regular appearance; apply diminish-increase at rest to the regular appearance day to obtain the fixed appearance day and parts.

sentences.zh: 五星休王光不同，喜怒盛衰大小尤異。

translations.literal: The five planets' rest and exaltation brightness differ; joy, anger, flourishing, waning, large and small especially differ.
translations.idiomatic: The five planets differ in brightness at rest and at exaltation; their phases of joy, anger, flourishing, and waning, and their apparent sizes, differ especially.

sentences.zh: 苟變於常見或先後，今依日躔遲速考其行，度其格，以去日為之定準。

translations.literal: If it varies from regular appearance in time, earlier or later, now according to solar motion's slowness and speed examine its motion, measure its position, using distance from sun as the fixed standard.
translations.idiomatic: When appearance varies from the regular date, whether early or late, examine its motion according to the sun's varying speed, measure its position, and take its distance from the sun as the fixed standard.

sentences.zh: 求星見所在度術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the degree where the star appears
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding the Degree Where the Star Appears

sentences.zh: 置星定見日夜半日所在宿度算及分，半其日躔差，乘定見餘，半總而一，進加退減定見餘，以加夜半度分，乃以其星初見去日度數，晨減夕加之，即星初見辰所在。

translations.literal: Set the star's fixed appearance day midnight sun's lodge degree count and parts; halve the solar motion difference, multiply the fixed appearance remainder, halve the half-total and one; advance add retreat subtract the fixed appearance remainder, to add to midnight degree parts; then with that star's first appearance distance-from-sun degree count—in morning subtract, in evening add—that is the star first appearance chen location.
translations.idiomatic: Set the lodge-degree count and parts of the sun at midnight on the star's fixed appearance day; halve the solar motion difference, multiply by the fixed appearance remainder, and divide by the half-total; add for advance and subtract for retreat to the fixed appearance remainder, and add this to the midnight degree and parts; then apply that star's first-appearance solar distance—in the morning subtract and in the evening add—to obtain the lodge where the star first appears.

sentences.zh: 宿度等及分行星術

translations.literal: Procedure for lodge degrees and stepping the planets
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Lodge Degrees and Stepping the Planets

sentences.zh: 各置其星初見日消息定數，半之，息加消減，其星初見行留日率。

translations.literal: Each set that star's first appearance day's correction constant, halve it, at rest add diminish-reduce, its star first appearance motion-station day rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, set its first-appearance day's correction constant, halve it, and at rest add or diminish to adjust its first-appearance motion-and-station day rate.

sentences.zh: 其土木二星不須加減，即依本術。

translations.literal: For Jupiter and Saturn the two stars need not add-subtract; then follow the base procedure.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter and Saturn, no add-subtract adjustment is needed; follow the base procedure.

sentences.zh: 其加減不滿日者，與見通之。

translations.literal: If add-subtract does not fill a day, combine with appearance.
translations.idiomatic: If the add-subtract adjustment does not amount to a full day, combine it with the appearance date.

sentences.zh: 過半從一日，無半不從論。

translations.literal: If over half, carry one day; without half, do not carry.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder exceeds half, carry one day; if it does not reach half, do not carry.

sentences.zh: 乃依行星日度之率，求日之行分。

translations.literal: Then according to the planet motion day-degree rate, seek the day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Then, according to the planet's day-and-degree motion rate, obtain the day's motion parts.

sentences.zh: 求初見日後夜半星所在術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding where the star stands at midnight after the first appearance day
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding Where the Star Stands at Midnight After the First Appearance Day

sentences.zh: 置其星定見餘，以減半總，以其星初見行分乘之，半總而一，以順加逆減星初見定辰所在度分。

translations.literal: Set the star's fixed appearance remainder, subtract from half-total, multiply by that star's first appearance motion parts, halve total and one, by direct add reverse subtract star first appearance fixed chen location degree parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the star's fixed appearance remainder, subtract it from the half-total, multiply by that star's first-appearance motion parts, and divide by the half-total; add for direct motion and subtract for retrograde to the star's first-appearance fixed chen location in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 加之滿法，減之不足，進退一度。

translations.literal: If adding fills the divisor, if subtracting is insufficient, advance or retreat one degree.
translations.idiomatic: If addition fills the divisor, or subtraction falls short, advance or retreat one degree.

sentences.zh: 依前命之算外，即星見後夜半所在宿度及分。

translations.literal: According to prior assignation count outside, that is star after appearance midnight lodge degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count outside the prior assignation to obtain the star's lodge degree and parts at midnight after appearance.

sentences.zh: 自此已後，每依其星計日行度，所至日度及益疾，皆從夜半為始。

translations.literal: From here onward, each according to its star compute daily motion degrees; where arrived day degree and increasing speed, all from midnight as start.
translations.idiomatic: From here onward, for each star compute the daily motion in degrees; the day-degree reached and any increase in speed are all reckoned from midnight.

sentences.zh: 辰有少，隨所近也。

translations.literal: If chen has remainder, follow what is nearest.
translations.idiomatic: If the chen has a fractional remainder, follow whichever is nearest.

sentences.zh: 轉求次日夜半星行所至術

translations.literal: Procedure for stepping to where the star reaches at the next day's midnight
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Stepping to Where the Star Reaches at the Next Day's Midnight

sentences.zh: 各以其星一日所行度及分，順逆加減之。

translations.literal: Each with that star one day motion degree and parts, direct reverse add subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For each star, add or subtract its one-day motion in degrees and parts according to direct or retrograde motion.

sentences.zh: 其行有小分者，以日率為母。

translations.literal: If motion has small parts, use day rate as denominator.
translations.idiomatic: If the motion has fractional small parts, use the day rate as denominator.

sentences.zh: 小分滿母，去之，從行分一。

translations.literal: Small parts fill denominator, remove, carry from motion parts one.
translations.idiomatic: When the small parts fill the denominator, remove them and carry one into the motion parts.

sentences.zh: 行分滿半總，去之，從度一。

translations.literal: Motion parts fill half-total, remove, carry from degree one.
translations.idiomatic: When the motion parts fill the half-total, remove them and carry one into the degrees.

sentences.zh: 其行有益疾益遲者，副置一日行分。

translations.literal: If motion has increasing speed or increasing slowness, separately set one day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the motion has increasing speed or increasing slowness, set aside the one-day motion parts separately.

sentences.zh: 各以其差遲損疾加之，留者因前，逆則依減。

translations.literal: Each with its difference slowness diminish speed add; if stationary continue prior, if retrograde then depend on subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For each, add the slowness-or-speed difference as diminish or increase; if stationary, continue from the prior value; if retrograde, subtract accordingly.

sentences.zh: 順行出鬥去其分，逆行入鬥先加分。

translations.literal: Direct motion exiting Dipper remove its parts, retrograde motion entering Dipper first add parts.
translations.idiomatic: In direct motion exiting the Dipper, remove its parts; in retrograde motion entering the Dipper, first add the parts.

sentences.zh: 訖，皆以程法約行分為度分，各得每日所至。

translations.literal: When done, all use rule factor to reduce motion parts to degree parts, each obtain daily arrival.
translations.idiomatic: When this is done, reduce the motion parts to degree parts by the rule factor for each day's arrival.

sentences.zh: 其五星後順留退所終日度，各依伏度，求其去日遠近，消息日度之所在，以定伏日所在。

translations.literal: The five planets' later direct, station, retreat terminal day degrees, each according to invisibility degrees, seek their distance from sun near and far, message day degree location, to fix invisibility day location.
translations.idiomatic: For the five planets' later direct, stationary, and retrograde terminal day-degrees, use each star's invisibility degree to find its solar distance, near or far, and the day-degree reached by diminish-increase, thereby fixing the invisibility day.

sentences.zh: 若注曆，其日度及金水等星，皆棄其分也。

translations.literal: If annotating calendar, the day degrees and Metal-Water and other stars, all discard their parts.
translations.idiomatic: When annotating the calendar, discard the fractional parts for day-degrees and for Venus, Mercury, and the other stars.

sentences.zh: 求平行度及分術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding mean motion degree and parts
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding Mean Motion Degree and Parts

sentences.zh: 置定度率，以半總乘之，以有分者從之，以日率除之，所得，為一日行分。

translations.literal: Set fixed degree rate, multiply by half-total, what has parts follows, divide by day rate, what is obtained is one day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed degree rate, multiply by the half-total, carry any parts forward, divide by the day rate, and the quotient is the one-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡小分滿其行分。

translations.literal: Undivided small parts fill its motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Any undivided small parts are carried into the motion parts.

sentences.zh: 滿半總為度。

translations.literal: Fill half-total becomes degree.
translations.idiomatic: When the parts fill the half-total, convert them to a degree.

sentences.zh: 即是一日所行度及行分、小分。

translations.literal: That is one day motion degree and motion parts, small parts.
translations.idiomatic: This gives the one-day motion in degrees, motion parts, and small parts.

sentences.zh: 置定日率，減一日，以所差分乘之，二而一，為差率。

translations.literal: Set fixed day rate, subtract one day, multiply by applied difference parts, divide by two, is difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed day rate, subtract one day, multiply by the applied difference in parts, and divide by two to obtain the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 益疾者以差率減平行分，益遲者以差率加平行分，即是初日所行度及分。

translations.literal: Increasing speed use difference rate subtract mean motion parts, increasing slowness use difference rate add mean motion parts, that is first day motion degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For increasing speed, subtract the difference rate from the mean motion parts; for increasing slowness, add it; this yields the first day's motion in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 星名星行變日初行入氣曆行日率行度及度分率：損益率。

translations.literal: Star name, star motion, change day, first motion entering qi calendar, motion day rate, motion degree and degree-parts rate: diminish-increase rate.
translations.idiomatic: Star name, star motion, change day, first motion entering-qi calendar, motion day rate, motion degree and degree-parts rate: diminish-increase rate.

sentences.zh: 歲星：初順，差行一百一十四日，行十八度五百九遲一分先疾，日益十四日。

translations.literal: Jupiter: first direct, differential motion one hundred fourteen days, moves eighteen degrees five hundred nine parts slow one part first then fast, daily increase fourteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter: first direct motion, differential 114 days, travels 18°509 parts—one part slow at first, then fast—with a daily increase of 14 parts.

sentences.zh: 前留，二十六日。

translations.literal: Prior station, twenty-six days.
translations.idiomatic: Prior station: 26 days.

sentences.zh: 旋退西行，差行三十日，退六度十二分。

translations.literal: Revolving retreat westward motion, differential thirty days, retreats six degrees twelve parts.
translations.idiomatic: Revolving retreat, moving westward: differential 30 days, retreats 6°12 parts.

sentences.zh: 先遲，日益疾二分。

translations.literal: First slow, daily increase speed two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Slow at first, with speed increasing by 2 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 又退西行，差行四十二日，退六度十二分。

translations.literal: Again retreat westward motion, differential forty-two days, retreats six degrees twelve parts.
translations.idiomatic: Again retreats westward: differential 42 days, retreats 6°12 parts.

sentences.zh: 先疾，日益遲二分。

translations.literal: First fast, daily increase slowness two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Fast at first, with slowness increasing by 2 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 後留，二十五日。

translations.literal: Later station, twenty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: Later station: 25 days.

sentences.zh: 後順，差行一百一十四日，行十八度五百九。

translations.literal: Later direct, differential motion one hundred fourteen days, moves eighteen degrees five hundred nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: Later direct motion: differential 114 days, travels 18°509 parts.

sentences.zh: 先進遲，日益疾分日盡而夕伏十四日。

translations.literal: First advancing slow, daily increase speed parts until days exhausted and evening invisibility fourteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Slow at first while advancing, with speed increasing daily in parts until the days are exhausted; evening invisibility: 14 days.

sentences.zh: 熒惑：初順，入冬至初日，率二百四十三日行一百六十五度。

translations.literal: Mars: first direct, entering Winter Solstice first day, rate two hundred forty-three days moves one hundred sixty-five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Mars: first direct motion, from the Winter Solstice on the first day, rate 243 days for 165 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自後三日損日及度各三。

translations.literal: From then every three days diminish day and degree each three.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, every three days diminish the day count and degree count each by three.

sentences.zh: 小寒初日，二百三十五日行一百五十四度。

translations.literal: Minor Cold first day, two hundred thirty-five days moves one hundred fifty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At Minor Cold on the first day: 235 days for 154 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自後二日損日及度各三。

translations.literal: From then every two days diminish day and degree each three.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, every two days diminish the day count and degree count each by three.

sentences.zh: 穀雨四日，平，畢小滿九日。

translations.literal: Grain Rain four days, mean, through Minor Fullness nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain Rain for four days at the mean rate through Minor Fullness for nine days.

sentences.zh: 一百七十八日行一百度。

translations.literal: One hundred seventy-eight days moves one hundred degrees.
translations.idiomatic: 178 days for 100 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自入小滿九日已後，二日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Fullness nine days afterward, every two days increase day and degree each one.
translations.idiomatic: From nine days after entering Minor Fullness, every two days increase the day count and degree count each by one.

sentences.zh: 夏至初日，平，畢六日。

translations.literal: Summer Solstice first day, mean, through six days.
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice on the first day at the mean rate through six days.

sentences.zh: 一百七十一日行九十三度。

translations.literal: One hundred seventy-one days moves ninety-three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: 171 days for 93 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至六日已後，三日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: From entering Summer Solstice six days afterward, every three days increase day and degree each one.
translations.idiomatic: From six days after entering the Summer Solstice, every three days increase the day count and degree count each by one.

sentences.zh: 立秋初日，一百八十四日行一百六度。

translations.literal: Start of Autumn first day, one hundred eighty-four days moves one hundred six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At the Start of Autumn on the first day: 184 days for 106 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自後一日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: From then every one day increase day and degree each one.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, every day increase the day count and degree count each by one.

sentences.zh: 白露初日，二百一十四日行一百三十六度。

translations.literal: White Dew first day, two hundred fourteen days moves one hundred thirty-six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At White Dew on the first day: 214 days for 136 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自後五日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: From then every five days increase day and degree each one.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, every five days increase the day count and degree count each by one.

sentences.zh: 秋分初日，二百三十二日行一百五十四度。

translations.literal: Autumn Equinox first day, two hundred thirty-two days moves one hundred fifty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At the Autumn Equinox on the first day: 232 days for 154 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自後一日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: From then every one day increase day and degree each one.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, every day increase the day count and degree count each by one.

sentences.zh: 寒露初日，二百四十七日行一百六十九度。

translations.literal: Cold Dew first day, two hundred forty-seven days moves one hundred sixty-nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At Cold Dew on the first day: 247 days for 169 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自後五日益日及度各二。

translations.literal: From then every five days increase day and degree each two.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, every five days increase the day count and degree count each by two.

sentences.zh: 霜降五日，平，畢立冬十三日。

translations.literal: Frost's Descent five days, mean, through Start of Winter thirteen days.
translations.idiomatic: From Frost's Descent for five days at the mean rate through the Start of Winter for thirteen days.

sentences.zh: 二百五十九日行一百八十一度。

translations.literal: Two hundred fifty-nine days moves one hundred eighty-one degrees.
translations.idiomatic: 259 days for 181 degrees.

sentences.zh: 自入立冬十三日已後，二日損日及度各一。

translations.literal: From entering Start of Winter thirteen days afterward, every two days diminish day and degree each one.
translations.idiomatic: From thirteen days after entering the Start of Winter, every two days diminish the day count and degree count each by one.

sentences.zh: 復冬至初日，二百四十二日行一百六十五度。

translations.literal: Again Winter Solstice first day, two hundred forty-two days moves one hundred sixty-five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Again at the Winter Solstice on the first day: 242 days for 165 degrees.

sentences.zh: 各依所入恆氣，平者依率，自餘計日損益，名為前疾日度定率。

translations.literal: Each according to entered mean qi, where mean follow rate, from remainder compute daily diminish-increase, named prior-fast day-degree fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each mean qi entered, where the rate is mean follow the base rate; from the remainder compute daily diminish-increase—this is called the prior-fast fixed day-and-degree rate.

sentences.zh: 其前遲及留退入氣有損益日度者，計日損益，皆同此疾之法，以為遲留旋退定日度之率也。

translations.literal: The prior slow and station-retreat entering qi where diminish-increase day-degree, compute daily diminish-increase, all same as this fast method, to serve as slow-station-revolving-retreat fixed day-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: For prior slow motion and station-retreat entering qi where day-and-degree diminish-increase applies, compute daily diminish-increase by the same method as for fast motion, to obtain the fixed day-and-degree rates for slow, stationary, and revolving-retreat phases.

sentences.zh: 求變日率術：此疾，入大寒六日，損日率一，畢雨水。

translations.literal: Procedure for finding change day rate: this fast phase, entering Major Cold six days, diminish day rate one, through Rain Water.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the change day rate: in this fast phase, from six days into Major Cold, diminish the day rate by one through Rain Water.

sentences.zh: 入春分，畢立夏，減日率十。

translations.literal: Entering Spring Equinox through Start of Summer, reduce day rate ten.
translations.idiomatic: From the Spring Equinox through the Start of Summer, reduce the day rate by ten.

sentences.zh: 入小滿初，減日率十。

translations.literal: Entering Minor Fullness first, reduce day rate ten.
translations.idiomatic: At Minor Fullness on the first day, reduce the day rate by ten.

sentences.zh: 後三日損所減一。

translations.literal: Afterward every three days diminish what was reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, every three days diminish the reduction by one.

sentences.zh: 畢芒種，依平。

translations.literal: Through Grain in Ear, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: Through Grain in Ear, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 若入立秋，三日益日率一，畢處暑。

translations.literal: If entering Start of Autumn, every three days increase day rate one, through End of Heat.
translations.idiomatic: From the Start of Autumn, increase the day rate by one every three days through End of Heat.

sentences.zh: 入白露，畢秋分，均加率十。

translations.literal: Entering White Dew through Autumn Equinox, uniformly add rate ten.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew through the Autumn Equinox, uniformly add ten to the rate.

sentences.zh: 入寒露初，加率十。

translations.literal: Entering Cold Dew first, add rate ten.
translations.idiomatic: At Cold Dew on the first day, add ten to the rate.

sentences.zh: 後一日半損所加一。

translations.literal: Afterward every one and a half days diminish what was added by one.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, every day and a half diminish the addition by one.

sentences.zh: 畢氣盡，依平。

translations.literal: Through qi exhausted, follow mean.
translations.idiomatic: Once the qi period is exhausted, follow the mean rate.

sentences.zh: 求變度率術：此疾，若入大寒，畢於啟蟄，立夏至大暑氣盡，霜降畢小雪，皆加度率四。

translations.literal: Procedure for finding change degree rate: this fast phase, if entering Major Cold through Awakening of Insects, Summer Solstice through Major Heat qi exhausted, Frost's Descent through Minor Snow, all add degree rate four.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for finding the change degree rate: in this fast phase, from Major Cold through Awakening of Insects, from the Summer Solstice through Major Heat until the qi is exhausted, and from Frost's Descent through Minor Snow, add four to the degree rate in each case.

sentences.zh: 清明畢穀雨，加率度十二。

translations.literal: Clear Brightness through Grain Rain, add rate degree twelve.
translations.idiomatic: From Clear Brightness through Grain Rain, add twelve to the rate in degrees.

sentences.zh: 初行入處暑，減日率六十，度率三十。

translations.literal: First motion entering End of Heat, reduce day rate sixty, degree rate thirty.
translations.idiomatic: At first motion entering End of Heat, reduce the day rate by sixty and the degree rate by thirty.

sentences.zh: 別為初遲半度之行，行盡此日度，及來所減之餘日度之率續為疾。

translations.literal: Separately make prior-slow half-degree motion, motion exhaust this day-degree, and the remainder day-degree rate of what was reduced continues as fast.
translations.idiomatic: Set apart a prior-slow half-degree motion; when this day-degree is exhausted, the remaining day-and-degree rate from the reduction continues as fast motion.

sentences.zh: 入白露，畢秋分，四十四日行二十二度。

translations.literal: Entering White Dew through Autumn Equinox, forty-four days moves twenty-two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew through the Autumn Equinox: 44 days for 22 degrees.

sentences.zh: 皆為初遲半度之率。

translations.literal: All are prior-slow half-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: All of these use the prior-slow half-degree rate.

sentences.zh: 初行入大寒，畢大暑，差行，先疾，日益遲一分。

translations.literal: First motion entering Major Cold through Major Heat, differential motion, first fast, daily increase slowness one part.
translations.idiomatic: First motion from Major Cold through Major Heat: differential motion, fast at first, with slowness increasing by one part per day.

sentences.zh: 各如上法，求其行分。

translations.literal: Each as above method, seek its motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For each, obtain the motion parts by the method above.

sentences.zh: 其前遲後日率，既有增損，而益遲益疾若分，皆檢括前疾末日行分，為前遲初日行分。

translations.literal: The prior slow latter day rate, since there is increase-diminish, and increasing slowness increasing speed like parts, all inspect prior fast last day motion parts, as prior slow first day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: When the prior slow phase's latter day rate has been increased or diminished, and increasing slowness or increasing speed applies to the parts, take the prior fast phase's last-day motion parts as the prior slow phase's first-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 以前遲平行分減之，餘為前遲總差。

translations.literal: Use prior slow mean motion parts subtract it, remainder is prior slow total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the prior slow mean motion parts; the remainder is the prior slow total difference.

sentences.zh: 後疾日分，為後遲末日行分。

translations.literal: Latter fast day parts, as latter slow last day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: The latter fast phase's day parts serve as the latter slow phase's last-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 為後遲日行分減之，餘為後總差。

translations.literal: Use latter slow day motion parts subtract it, remainder is latter total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the latter slow phase's daily motion parts; the remainder is the latter total difference.

sentences.zh: 減為後別日差分。

translations.literal: The subtraction gives latter separate day difference parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result of the subtraction is the latter separate day-difference parts.

sentences.zh: 其不滿者，皆調為小分。

translations.literal: What does not reach full, all adjust to minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: Any remainder that does not amount to a full unit is adjusted into minor parts.

sentences.zh: 遲疾之際，行分衰殺不論。

translations.literal: At junctures of slow and fast, motion-part decay and diminish are not considered.
translations.idiomatic: At transitions between slow and fast motion, decay and diminish of motion parts are not counted.

sentences.zh: 所差多者，依此推算。

translations.literal: Where the difference is large, calculate by this method.
translations.idiomatic: Where the discrepancy is large, compute by this procedure.

sentences.zh: 若所差不多者，各依本法。

translations.literal: If the difference is not large, each follows the original method.
translations.idiomatic: If the discrepancy is slight, each case follows the base method.

sentences.zh: 前遲：順，差行，入冬至，六十日行二十五度。
